name: 1Password
desc: Password manager and security platform for teams: store and share passwords, passkeys and secrets with autofill, breach monitoring and developer secrets management — enterprise-grade vaults with simple admin controls.

name: 800.com
desc: Toll-free and vanity phone numbers for business, with call tracking, routing and analytics — plus 800 AI Agents (launched 2026) that answer calls, book appointments and filter spam when nobody picks up.

name: accessiBe
desc: Web-accessibility widget (accessWidget) that scans a site every 24 hours and adjusts it in the browser — contrast, text sizing, keyboard hints — plus an accessibility statement. Priced by monthly visits, with a monthly and a yearly rate on every tier: $59 a month or $490 a year up to 5,000 visits, $179 or $1,490 up to 30,000, $479 or $3,990 up to 100,000 (read 10 Sep 2026). An aid, not WCAG conformance — for that the same vendor sells accessFlow (developer audits with ready-to-commit code fixes) and accessServices (VPATs, file remediation, expert audits), both quoted rather than priced publicly.

name: ActiveCampaign
desc: Marketing automation and lifecycle email with a light CRM attached. Priced by contact count from about $15/month on Starter, with CRM pipelines, SMS and extra seats sold as add-ons — the sticker price sits well below what a real automation setup costs.

name: AdCreative.ai
desc: AI ad-creative and banner generation for performance marketers. Metered by download rather than by campaign: tiers run from roughly $29–39/month for 10 credits up to $1,399/month for 200, so iteration-heavy testing burns a starter allowance fast.

name: ADP
desc: Payroll, tax filing and HR for small and mid-sized employers, sold as four RUN packages: Essential, Enhanced, Complete and HR Pro. No public pricing anywhere — /pricing is a 404 and every tier on the comparison page says “Get pricing”, so budgeting means a sales call.

name: Adwisely
desc: Automated retargeting and prospecting ads on Meta and Google for Shopify, WooCommerce and BigCommerce stores. Costs a $49/month minimum plus 10% of the ad spend it manages (capped at $3,250 a month), so work the effective rate out at your own spend.

name: AfterSell
desc: Post-purchase upsell and cross-sell app for Shopify (by Rokt): one-click upsells, downsells and thank-you-page offers plus checkout customization to lift average order value — no extra ad spend.

name: AgencyAnalytics
desc: Client reporting and dashboards built for marketing agencies: aggregate 85+ marketing platforms into white-label dashboards and automated reports, with per-client KPI goals. White-labeling on every plan.

name: AgentNest
desc: Scans your Shopify catalogue for the product-data gaps AI shopping surfaces trip over — status, category, description, image alt text — and applies the eligible ones in a click. Scanning, the readiness score and the full issue report are free and unlimited; you pay only for applied fixes, at $19, $49 or $99 a month for 100, 1,000 or 5,000 a month. Launched 6 August 2026 with no reviews yet.

name: AhaSlides
desc: Interactive presentation platform — live polls, quizzes, word clouds and audience Q&A, free for up to 50 participants.

name: Aira
desc: AI-assisted B2B prospecting on a Europe-native company database, with meeting notes flowing into records automatically. About €149/month, with a money-back guarantee. The product is young and independent review coverage is thin, so test it against a concrete metric of your own.

name: Aircall
desc: Cloud phone system for sales and support teams: call routing, analytics and CRM integrations. A three-licence minimum applies, so entry is effectively about $90/month; Essentials is roughly $30/user/month annual against $40 month-to-month.

name: Airia
desc: Enterprise AI security and governance platform. Read on 1 September 2026, the vendor leads with finding AI rather than building it: Airia says it discovers every AI tool, model, agent and MCP server running across an organisation, including the ones nobody approved, enforces policy at the execution layer before a tool call fires or an email sends, and generates continuous governance documentation mapped to the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, SR 11-7, HIPAA, ISO 42001 and SOC 2. The no-code/low-code/pro-code agent builder, connectors and MCP support are still there, but now sit under Optimize alongside model routing and cost controls. Its July 2026 update, as the vendor describes it, added Model Change Management, which warns up to 90 days before a model deprecation so agents do not break silently; Advanced Context Engineering, aimed at running governed AI over complex, permission-sensitive enterprise data; and cost controls that watch budgets in real time, attribute spend per provider, model, agent and team, and flag runaway agent loops.
Multi-currency business accounts, corporate cards, international transfers and payment acceptance.
name: Airwallex
AISDR
desc: Deploy an autonomous AI Sales Development Rep. It qualifies leads, books meetings, and handles initial outreach conversations 24/7.

name: AISQ
desc: An autonomous marketing execution engine. Consolidates SEO, content distribution, and strategy into one automated workflow.

name: Algomo
desc: AI inbound agent and website personalization for B2B — qualifies visitors by identity, holds contextual conversations and books meetings from your existing traffic.

name: Alidrop
desc: Dropshipping automation — product sourcing, fulfilment and inventory sync, with access to faster-shipping US and EU suppliers. Plans run $39/month for 50 unique products up to $299. The subscription sits on top of wholesale cost, so margins still turn on product selection and ad efficiency.

name: Alli AI
desc: Agency-grade SEO automation — bulk on-page optimizations, rules and keyword tracking across multiple sites and CMSes from one dashboard.

name: Alohi
desc: One secure ecosystem for document workflows: Sign.Plus e-signatures, Fax.Plus online faxing and Scan.Plus scanning — paperwork handled, compliance included.

name: AltText.ai
desc: Bulk AI alt-text generation for image-heavy sites: crawls your pages or plugs into your CMS (WordPress, Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Contentful, DatoCMS) and writes the alt attributes back automatically, in 130+ languages. Credit-metered — 25 free credits to try, then from $5/mo for 100 images.

name: Alvys
desc: Cloud-native transportation management system (TMS) unifying trucking carriers and freight brokers in one platform — dispatch, billing, DOT/IFTA compliance, real-time load visibility and native EDI (no third-party middleware), so new shippers connect in hours rather than weeks.

name: Amplemarket
desc: An all-in-one AI sales platform: an AI 'Searcher' that turns a plain-English ICP into verified contacts, 100+ contact-level buying-intent signals, and social prospecting from LinkedIn, plus multichannel outreach and deliverability tooling — drawing on a large multi-source contact database it refreshes continuously. Its Duo copilot proactively surfaces prioritized leads from 20+ real-time signal types, and an MCP server puts the platform inside ChatGPT or Claude — where it can triage the Unibox, update or remove leads, and since July run a whole account-based play end to end: research the account, pull enriched profiles, and enrol every contact into one sequence with copy written per person and per step, without leaving the chat. A GTM Skills Library exposes the rest of the platform the same way. Duo Voice is the audio arm of the same copilot: you read one short sample aloud, it clones your voice, and a voice-message step can then be dropped into any sequence, with the message written per prospect from their data and adapted to their language — LinkedIn voice notes rather than another block of text. Since June you can also describe a workflow in plain English and have it built for you in the normal editor, and meeting notes from Fathom and Attention flow into the activity feed. Deliverability is a named toolkit rather than a footnote: a Domain Health Center for SPF/DKIM/DMARC, inbox-to-outbox ratio, spam-list and mailbox-age monitoring; automated warm-up and recovery for flagged Gmail or Outlook mailboxes; weekly spam-placement tests before a campaign goes out; and Duo rotating the sending mailbox per email against that same health data. Workflows, the automation layer, is included for every customer rather than sold as a premium add-on: triggers (a sequence finishing with no reply, a bounce, a meeting booked, a call logged, a CRM field changing), filters for who qualifies, branching paths and actions (enrol in another sequence, update CRM fields, create tasks, manage lists, enrich, add to exclusion lists), assembled on a visual canvas so the whole logic is readable at a glance. Twenty ready-made Recipes cover lead routing, keeping non-responders warm, account plays, CRM hygiene and do-not-contact enforcement. It runs against Salesforce and HubSpot out of the box, and without a CRM connected the triggers and actions that don't depend on one still work. The browser extension carries the same work into whatever page you are on: adding and editing notes, creating and running tasks, and filtering the activity feed without switching tabs.
Product analytics: funnels, retention and behavioural cohorts, plus session replay and experimentation.
name: Amplitude
Answering Service Care
desc: US-based live answering with real people, 24/7 and bilingual English/Spanish, with call transfers, SMS and email relays, a client portal and app on every plan. Monthly plans run $40 Starter, $179 Small Business (100 minutes), $329 Pro (250) and $639 Enterprise (500), around 10% off if you pay a year upfront. Read the small print first: Starter includes zero minutes, there is a $50 start-up fee that the plan cards leave out and the FAQ spells out, and the explanation below the table still quotes three prices that do not match the table above it (read 10 Sep 2026).

name: Aplos
desc: Fund accounting built for nonprofits and faith-based organisations, tracking restricted and unrestricted money separately. Lite is $79/month for 2 users, then $129 and $229. A 50%-off-for-three-months promotion was running again in September 2026, under a new code and to a new date, so check what month four costs.

name: Apollo
desc: Sales intelligence and engagement platform with a large B2B contact database. Find ideal-fit leads, enrich them and run multichannel outreach from one place.

name: Arbor
desc: Free US service that automatically finds and switches you to a cheaper electricity supply rate in the 13 deregulated states (Northeast, Midwest, Texas). Your utility and wiring stay the same, no service interruption, cancel anytime — Arbor is paid a referral fee by the supplier, so households pay nothing.

name: AskNest
desc: Multilingual FAQ bot for the Shopify storefront that answers from your own FAQs, policy pages and product catalogue in seven languages, with product recommendations and best sellers. Free for 50 AI replies a month; paid runs $4.99, $9.99 or $19.99 a month for 500, 1,500 or 5,000 replies. Launched May 2026 with a single App Store review.

name: Aspire
desc: All-in-one finance stack for global businesses: multi-currency accounts (30+ currencies), corporate cards with 1.2% cashback, expense management, bill pay, payments and payroll — with AI fraud detection and multi-admin approval workflows.

name: Assembly
desc: Branded client portal for agencies and professional service firms: messaging, invoices, proposals, contracts and e-signatures in one place. Two meters run at once — Starter stops at 50 clients on $29/month billed yearly, and each extra internal user costs $29 on Professional and $59 on Advanced.

name: Atlas AI Store Builder
desc: Shopify app that builds a full store or product page from a single product link — layout, copy and images generated automatically, plus bundle and cart upsells. $39/month covers 5 pages, $1,000 of bundle revenue and 250 orders; past that the meter tracks your revenue.

name: Atria
desc: Competitor ad research and AI creative generation for Meta and TikTok in one platform. Credit-metered: Core is about $159/month ($129 annual) with 4,000 AI credits and 50 brands tracked, and heavy users step up to Plus at roughly twice that.

name: Atto
desc: Time tracking and timesheets for hourly and mobile teams. Track hours, breaks and locations with GPS and turn timesheets into payroll-ready reports.

name: Attribuly
desc: Recovers abandoned carts Klaviyo misses — identifies visitors, syncs intent signals back into Klaviyo and lets an AI agent send a personalised recovery email. Free until $1,000 of recovered revenue, then $450 or $500 a month.

name: Audiorista
desc: No-code platform for launching branded audio apps — podcasts, audiobooks, meditation and courses with subscriptions, on iOS, Android and web.
Dynamic repricing for Amazon and Walmart sellers — automated price strategy across marketplaces.
name: Aura
AutoWrite
desc: AI blog writer for Shopify with SEO scoring, scheduling and publishing. Free plan available. New to the App Store: zero reviews as of 18 Aug 2026.

name: Auware
desc: AI-built, audience-specific Shopify pages: automatically generates a personalized page per buyer persona — not just landing pages but advertorials, listicles, comparison and product (PDP) pages — with targeted headlines, social proof and FAQs, plus per-segment analytics. Built to lift ad conversion for DTC brands. No code.

name: Ava AI
desc: AI phone agent for Shopify stores: answers support calls 24/7 — order lookup, edits and refunds mid-call — and runs outbound abandoned-cart recovery calls, with recordings, transcripts and its own business number. Priced by call minutes.

name: AWeber
desc: Email marketing and automation for small businesses and creators: drag-and-drop newsletters, prompt-built landing pages, autoresponders and sign-up forms, AI writing help, and since August 2026 a ChatGPT plugin and Claude connector that read a whole automation back with its engagement numbers.

name: BabyLoveGrowth
desc: AI SEO/GEO content automation — auto-publishes optimized articles, builds backlinks and runs keyword research, aimed at fast hands-off organic growth for lean teams.

name: BackupMaster
desc: Automatic daily backups for Shopify: products, collections, themes, blogs, pages, files, metafields, metaobjects, translations, customers, orders and inventory, with 365-day retention and one-click restore; Pro adds downloadable copies, Google Drive sync and store duplication for staging. The free tier is for Shopify Partner dev stores only; live stores run $19, $39 or $79 a month for 300, 600 or 1,500 orders, 10% off annually.

name: Barcodes Talk
desc: Authentic UPC and EAN barcodes for retail and Amazon listings. Buy GS1-sourced barcodes for your products as a one-time purchase, without an annual GS1 membership.

name: Beautiful.ai
desc: Presentation builder whose templates lay themselves out as you type. Pro is about $12/month billed annually but $45 month-to-month — a steep gap — and the constraints that make decks look consistent also block pixel-level custom layouts.

name: Beefree
desc: RGE Studio (formerly Beefree — renamed 14 May 2026): drag-and-drop email and landing-page design. Build responsive, on-brand emails fast and export clean HTML to any major ESP, no coding required. Beefree remains the company name and the name of its separate developer SDK; the builder itself now lives under reallygoodemails.com.

name: Beehiiv
desc: Newsletter platform with growth, automation, SEO and monetisation tooling, priced by subscriber count. You keep 100% of paid subscriptions where Substack takes 10%; the trade is a steeper start than Substack's near-zero setup and built-in discovery.

name: BidX
desc: Amazon-advertising automation from German vendor BidX GmbH: bid and budget automation, campaign creation, dayparting and target-ACOS rules for Sponsored Products, Brands and Display, with Amazon DSP and Marketing Cloud reporting and organic-plus-paid share-of-voice tracking in the same dashboard.

name: Bill.com
desc: Accounts-payable and receivable automation for finance teams with real approval chains. Priced per user from about $45/month, with transaction fees stacked on top — roughly $0.49 ACH, $1.99 cheque, $9.99 international wire, 2.9% card.

name: BillingNow
desc: Invoicing and expense tracking with AI — unlimited invoices, expenses, clients and users, at $9.99 a month or $99.90 a year, made in Geneva.

name: Birch
desc: Ad automation for performance marketers (formerly Revealbot): rule-based optimization, automated scaling and creative insights across Meta, Google, TikTok and Snapchat — run and optimize ad campaigns on autopilot.

name: Bitdefender
desc: GravityZone endpoint protection for small business, managed from one console. At 10 devices for a year the list prices are $32.50, $38.50 and $88.00 per device per year across the three tiers, and the configurator applies a 30% discount by default. Add-ons and setup are priced separately.

name: Bitscale
desc: GTM data layer that sits on top of your CRM: enrich records through waterfalls across 100+ B2B sources, track buying signals and run AI agents against the result. Free tier at 200 credits; paid from $349 a month for 15,000.

name: Bitvavo
desc: Dutch-regulated, euro-native crypto exchange with deep EUR pairs and an API for automation. No subscription — the base tier under €100k monthly volume runs about 0.15% maker and 0.25% taker, dropping through ten volume tiers. Sign up via our link for €10K fee-free.

name: Blinq
desc: Digital business cards shared by QR code or link, with contacts syncing into your CRM. A free plan covers two cards; Business is about $4.99/user/month annual with a five-user minimum, and the event lead-capture add-on starts near $199/month.

name: Blocky
desc: Shopify fraud filter that blocks visitors and orders by country, IP (v4 and v6), email, name, address and phone, with an AI bot blocker for TOR, proxy and VPN traffic that gets past reCAPTCHA, country redirects, a right-click blocker and visitor analytics. The free tier is for development stores only; live stores run $9.99 for country blocking, $16.99 with IP blocking or $19.99 for the identity and bot filters, 30% off annually. Not sold to Shopify Plus stores.

name: Bokun
desc: Booking management for tours and activities, by Tripadvisor. Manage availability, channel sales and online bookings in one place — built for experience businesses.

name: Bolt Business
desc: Business travel and mobility management. Give your team expense-tracked rides and travel with centralized billing and reporting.

name: BookX
desc: Shopify appointment booking that lives in the storefront: Calendly-style slots for services, classes, rentals and events, with staff and multi-location schedules, deposits and partial payments, and the money taken at your own checkout. Bookings are unlimited on every tier — the ladder is gated on locations and team members. Free covers 1 service and 1 team member; Starter $9.99 a month or $107.99 a year, Growth $19.99 or $203.99, Business $39.99 or $407.99, for 5, 10 and 20 locations and team members. Read 8 Sep 2026.

name: Bookyourdata
desc: B2B email lists and verified contact data on demand. Build targeted prospect lists with verified business emails and pay only for the contacts you need.
Booking, point of sale and client management for salons, spas and self-care businesses.
name: Boulevard
Bouncer
desc: Email-list verification sold as credits that never expire: $8 per 1,000 (also the minimum purchase), falling to about $2 per 1,000 at the top volume. Unknowns and duplicates are not charged. Treat 'accept-all' domain results as unverified.

name: Bread & Butter
desc: Lead-intelligence platform with server-side tracking: captures the full visitor journey from the first visit, then enriches, scores and nurtures the moment someone submits an email — verified identities instead of IP-based company guesses. 30-day full trial, then a genuinely usable freemium tier; Pro from $49 per website.

name: Breezy HR
desc: Recruiting and applicant tracking made simple. Post jobs to 50+ boards, manage candidates on a visual pipeline, and automate scheduling and screening.

name: Brevo
desc: Email, SMS and a light CRM, priced by monthly send volume rather than contact count — cheaper for a large list you email selectively. Free forever at 300 emails a day and storage for up to 100,000 contacts; paid from about $9/month, and every paid send tier caps stored contacts too (5,000 sends a month stores up to 500). Model your real send volume if you mail frequently.

name: Bright Data
desc: The web data platform trusted by enterprises. Collect public web data at scale with proxies, ready-made datasets and scraping APIs — fuel for your market research and AI projects.

name: Browse.ai
desc: No-code web scraping and data extraction. Turn any website into an automated data pipeline or spreadsheet automatically.

name: BrowserAct
desc: No-code web scraper and browser-automation bots from one prompt, with managed browsers, residential proxies and CAPTCHA solving in one credit pool. Free tier with 1,500 credits; Basic $13/month on yearly billing ($20 monthly) for 10,000 credits, up to Advanced $96/$200 for 100,000. Monthly billing costs up to twice the yearly rate.

name: BuddyPunch
desc: Time clock and employee time tracking for hourly teams. Track hours, breaks, PTO and overtime with GPS and photo punch-in, and export payroll-ready reports.

name: BugHerd
desc: Visual bug tracking and website feedback. Let clients and teams point-and-click to report issues right on the page, turned into trackable tasks.

name: Buzz.ai
desc: AI-powered outbound platform: prompt it and it finds intent-ready buyers, writes multichannel sequences and books the meetings — per-seat plans with monthly credit allowances and a free start.

name: Bybit
desc: Crypto exchange covering spot, perpetuals and options. No subscription — spot is 0.1% maker and taker for non-VIP, derivatives around 0.02% and 0.055%, with volume tiers cutting lower. Funding rates on perpetuals are a recurring cost the fee table does not show, and availability differs per country.

name: Calilio
desc: Cloud phone system with international numbers and call menus, from about $12/user/month annual on Standard. Numbers, minutes and SMS meter separately from a credit balance, so an active team's real bill sits above the per-seat price.

name: CallHippo
desc: AI-driven business phone system. Virtual numbers in 50+ countries, power dialer, call analytics and AI agents — set up your sales and support calling in minutes. Its omnichannel inbox threads voice, WhatsApp, SMS, email, Instagram and Telegram into one conversation per customer.

name: CallRail
desc: Call tracking and attribution — which campaigns, keywords and ads produce phone calls and form leads. Plans run about $50–195/month, but included minutes, numbers and SMS are modest and overages meter at roughly $0.05 a local minute. It is an attribution layer, not a phone system or CRM.

name: Campaign Monitor
desc: Email campaigns with strong templates and client-friendly management for brands and agencies. Priced per contact rather than per send: Essentials at 10,000 contacts runs about $89/month, so dormant subscribers bill like active ones. Automation depth is lighter than dedicated platforms.

name: Campaigner
desc: Email and SMS marketing for mid-market senders with larger lists. The useful features start high — automation and API only arrive on Essential at about $179/month, while Starter at $59 is a sending tool rather than an automation platform. Contact-based pricing bills dormant subscribers too.

name: Capsule
desc: Deliberately simple CRM for small businesses: contacts, pipeline and tasks. Free for 250 contacts and two users, then about $21/user/month on Starter. The simplicity is the product — advanced automation, deep reporting and integrations thin out, and a scaling sales org can outgrow it.

name: Carbon6
desc: A suite of Amazon seller tools sold per product rather than as one subscription: Seller Investigators (FBA reimbursement recovery), ChargeGuard (1P vendor recovery for chargeback fees, shortages and accruals), PixelMe, DSP Prime and PPC Entourage (advertising), SoStocked (demand and inventory planning), ScanUnlimited (wholesale sourcing), plus ManageByStats, D8aDriven, AMZAlert and SellerAssist. Ownership matters here: SPS Commerce bought Carbon6 in Feb 2025 and folded the 1P deduction-recovery work into spscommerce.com, then transferred the 3P Amazon-seller business to Carbon6 on 30 Jun 2026 — the suite is sold under the Carbon6 brand again, with the partner programme rebranding from SPS to Carbon6 on 24 Aug 2026 and commission terms unchanged.

name: Castmagic
desc: Turns recorded audio and video into a stack of ready-to-use assets: transcripts in 60+ languages, show notes, summaries, newsletters, social posts, clips and audiograms, with custom prompts and an AI chat across your whole library. Billed annually at $19, $48 or $139 a month for 30, 100 or 400 transcribed hours; Business & Scale starts at $699 a month by demo.

name: ChatGPT AI Product Description
desc: Bulk copy generator for Shopify from Profitonium: product descriptions, titles, meta tags and image alt text for thousands of products at once, in 30+ languages, with custom instruction templates and automatic descriptions on import. Free tier gives 100 credits a month; paid runs $19, $49 or $249 a month for 2,000, 11,000 or 110,000 credits. Live since 2021, rated 4.9 over 466 App Store reviews.

name: Checkr
desc: AI-powered background check and screening platform for hiring: fast criminal, employment and identity verification with automated adjudication and ATS integrations — speeds up onboarding while staying FCRA-compliant.

name: ChemiCloud
desc: Lightning-fast cloud hosting with free migrations, daily backups, and 24/7 expert support. Perfect balance of performance and affordability for growing businesses.

name: Circle
desc: Community platform for creator businesses: discussions, courses, events, memberships and messaging in one branded home — plus a no-code website builder, branded iOS/Android apps, email marketing, a member CRM, built-in payments and AI agents that answer member questions.

name: Claap
desc: AI sales intelligence that records calls without putting a bot in the meeting, then turns them into CRM fields, follow-up emails, deal scoring and coaching. Basic is free; Pro is €24 per license a month on annual billing (€30 monthly); Business, which holds the CRM and coaching features, is €48 (€60 monthly) and quote-led.

name: Claude
desc: Anthropic's AI assistant for writing, coding, analysis and long-document work — strong reasoning and a careful, direct tone rather than an eager-to-please one. Free tier plus Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise plans, and a per-token API (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) for builders.

name: Clay
desc: Waterfall enrichment and custom research workflows for go-to-market teams. It enriches rather than sends, so you still need a separate email tool. From about $185/month (Launch, 2,500 credits) to $495 (Growth), with credit spend that is hard to forecast and a two-to-four-week learning curve.

name: ClickUp
desc: The 'everything app' for project and work management. Centralize your tasks, docs, sprints, and team communication in one hub.

name: Clonable
desc: Creates a continuously-translated clone of your existing website — fast multilingual versions that stay synced as your site changes, without rebuilding it.

name: Cloro
desc: API that reads AI search engines — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot, Gemini, Grok, AI Overview and Google Search — and returns the sources and citations behind every query as structured JSON.

name: Close
desc: Sales CRM unifying calling, email and SMS in one inbox, for teams that live on the phone. Seats run about $9 (Solo) to $139 (Scale) per user/month billed annually, and call, SMS and Power Dialer credits bill separately on top — a $99 plan can land nearer $160 once a rep dials all day.

name: CloudTalk
desc: Cloud call centre with call routing, analytics and CRM integrations, from €19/user/month on annual billing (Expert €49 needs at least three licences). AI voice agents are separate subscriptions from €99/month for 200 minutes, and number rental plus outbound minutes stack on top of the seat price.

name: CloudTask
desc: Managed marketplace for LATAM go-to-market hires — SDRs, BDRs and similar — with payroll and compliance handled. $299/month membership, plus an all-in monthly rate per hire that is not published. Direct Hire instead costs 30% of first-year salary.

name: Cloudways
desc: Managed-hosting layer that rents you servers on DigitalOcean, Vultr, Linode, AWS or Google Cloud through one dashboard, with the stack, caching, staging, cloning, backups and 24/7 platform support pre-built on top. You buy a server and put as many sites on it as it holds — no per-site plans and no visit metering — billed hourly and invoiced monthly in arrears with no contract. The trade is control: Cloudways' own documentation states there is no root access and no bring-your-own cloud account, so the server lives in Cloudways' name. Owned by DigitalOcean since September 2022.

name: Cloze
desc: AI shopping assistant for Shopify: a chat widget wired to your live catalogue, inventory and knowledge base that answers product questions, compares items, tracks orders and hands off to a human. Free for 25 conversations a month; paid runs $49, $99 or $199 a month on the App Store, with extra conversations at $0.10. New listing: no reviews yet as of 19 Aug 2026.

name: Clutch
desc: B2B services marketplace — submit a free project brief and get matched with verified, best-fit agencies for your project, no research required.

name: Code Bulk Discounts
desc: Shopify app (by Optizio) that turns a discount you have already created into thousands of unique codes and exports them as CSV for email and SMS campaigns. Free covers 500 lifetime codes; Pro is $14.99 a month for unlimited codes.
B2B contact data with a GDPR focus — phone-verified mobile numbers and intent signals.
name: Cognism
CometChat
desc: In-app text, voice and video chat infrastructure to embed into your own software — secure and scalable, with a free developer plan and, via the new Air release, fully on-prem or air-gapped deployment for regulated enterprises.

name: Compliancely
desc: Compliance and verification API for US businesses and individuals: real-time and bulk IRS TIN matching, KYB business verification, USPS address and Secretary of State lookups, Form I-9 and E-Verify, consent-based IRS tax transcript retrieval, and ongoing OFAC, watchlist and FATCA monitoring. Built by Zenwork, the company behind Tax1099.

name: Connecteam
desc: All-in-one app for managing deskless teams. Scheduling, time clock, tasks, training and team chat for hourly and frontline workforces.

name: Consensus
desc: AI search across peer-reviewed literature: it reports what published studies found, not whether those studies are sound. A free tier covers basic search; Pro is about $15/month, or roughly $10 billed annually. Study quality and conflicting results still need your own judgment.

name: Consentmo
desc: Shopify consent app that geolocates the visitor and shows the right GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA or LGPD banner, with Google Consent Mode v2 and Meta, Microsoft and TikTok signals, cookie scanning and data-request pages — plus an accessibility widget and scanner from the Plus tier. Banner impressions are unlimited on every tier. Free plan; Standard $10 a month or $100 a year, Plus $37 or $370, Enterprise $64 or $640. Read 8 Sep 2026.

name: Contractor Foreman
desc: Construction management — estimating, scheduling, daily logs and financial tracking — priced per company rather than per seat, with unlimited projects on every tier. Annual runs $49/month for one user up to $332 for unlimited; quarterly billing costs about 26% more and Basic is annual-only.

name: Convert
desc: Privacy-first A/B testing platform — experiments, personalization and feature rollouts, priced by tested users. Via our link: an exclusive 30-day full-access trial (standard is 15 days).

name: CrankWheel
desc: No-download screen sharing for sales calls — a prospect clicks a link and sees your screen on any device. Deliberately narrow: no video conferencing, webinars or collaboration. The free plan covers one user and 15 meetings a month; Solo is about $29/user/month.

name: Crazy Egg
desc: Website optimization with heatmaps, scroll maps, session recordings and A/B testing — see how visitors behave and lift conversions with data.

name: Credit Repair Cloud
desc: Software for running a credit-repair business: client management, dispute automation and letter workflows. It is not a tool for repairing your own credit. Plans run from about $49/month (Personal) to $599 (Enterprise), scaling by active clients and seats.
Endpoint protection built around a cloud-delivered agent: antivirus, EDR and threat hunting.
name: CrowdStrike
Databox
desc: Centralized KPI dashboards. Pull data from all your software tools into one clean interface to monitor your business health. A free Skills Marketplace adds guided analyses on top: the paid-ads skill standardizes every ad channel into one efficiency table with CPA gauges against your own targets, judged per funnel role. A native MCP server (mcp.databox.com) puts those metrics inside ChatGPT or Claude — ingest data and query it in plain language. It runs on every paid plan, not on Free, and its queries spend from the same monthly AI-credit pool as Genie.

name: Datarails
desc: Excel-native FP&A platform for finance teams. Consolidation, planning, reporting and dashboards built on top of the spreadsheets you already use, with governed data behind them.

name: Deel
desc: Global hiring, payroll and EOR platform — pay contractors and employees compliantly in 150+ countries, from $49 per contractor per month, with HR tools and US PEO options.

name: Deputy
desc: Workforce management for hourly and shift-based teams: rota building, time clocking, timesheet approval and labour-law compliance, with payroll and HR integrations.

name: Descript
desc: AI-powered video and podcast editor: edit media by editing the text transcript — cut, overdub and remove filler words like editing a doc — with screen recording, AI voice cloning and an AI assistant (Underlord) built in.

name: Devs.ai
desc: Build and ship AI agents and apps across many models without engineering work. The seat price is the smaller half of the bill: Personal includes $10 of model usage a month and Business $21, metered on top — and the plan cards state the included amount without stating the rate once it runs out.

name: Dext
desc: Receipt and invoice capture that extracts the data and feeds it into Xero, QuickBooks or Sage. It is the capture layer, not accounting software, so you still need one of those. From about £24/month on Starter, and extraction accuracy varies enough to need manual correction.

name: Dify
desc: Source-available platform for LLM apps and agent workflows: visual builder, RAG pipelines, model-agnostic. The Community Edition is free of a software fee to self-host, but you own the servers, updates and reliability. Managed Dify Cloud runs $59/month on Professional, priced per workspace.

name: Diginius
desc: Digital marketing and e-commerce performance platform. Manage PPC, analytics and product feeds to improve online sales and visibility.

name: Digit
desc: Inventory, production, purchasing and sales in one system for manufacturers and distributors. Starter $400/month with 5 users, Growth $750, Professional $1,300, extra users $63 each. Watch the add-ons: a third integration is $100 to $125 a month, and API or MCP access is $125 each.

name: Disputifier
desc: Chargeback automation for Shopify: submits dispute evidence for you, buys chargeback alerts that refund incoming disputes before they land, and screens orders for fraud and late shipments. Free to install; recovery costs 20% of every won chargeback (capped at $250 a win), alerts run $17-$27.50 each and the two prevention add-ons $0.05 an order.

name: Dondy
desc: WhatsApp marketing and support for Shopify on the official WhatsApp Business API: abandoned-cart recovery, campaigns to Shopify segments, automated order messages, a shared inbox and an AI chatbot for sales and support. Free for the chat button; $6.99 a month for manual messages, $79.99 for automation and campaigns, $159.99 with the AI chatbot, plus Meta's own per-conversation charges from $0.0126.

name: doola
desc: Business formation and compliance made easy. Launch your US LLC or C-Corp from anywhere globally, complete with banking and tax management.

name: Drip
desc: Ecommerce email and onsite marketing built around your store's order data — segments, abandoned-cart and welcome playbooks, pop-ups and A/B testing, with one-click links to Shopify, WooCommerce and BigCommerce. Priced purely on list size from $39/month for 2,500 people, 14-day trial without a card. Two things the headline price hides: chat support only starts at $99/month, and the promised unlimited sends turn into a hard cap of twelve emails per contact per month somewhere above 25,000 contacts (read 12 Aug 2026).

name: Dripify
desc: Cloud-based LinkedIn outreach automation — drip sequences of connection requests, messages, InMails and profile views, with configurable daily limits and a built-in email finder. From $39 per user/month billed annually, 7-day free trial without a card.

name: Dripshipper
desc: Private-label coffee and tea dropshipping for Shopify: they roast, bag and ship from their own US facilities within 3-5 business days, with your brand on the packaging. Starter $30 a month or $240 a year, Professional $99, Elite $197, all with a 14-day trial and per-order product and shipping cost on top.

name: DropGenius
desc: Generates a Shopify dropshipping store — products, branding and copy — as a starting template, not a finished business. Monthly runs $39 to $299, and annual billing drops Starter. Trustpilot sat near 1.6/5 at research time, with recurring complaints about charges after cancellation.

name: Dryground AI
desc: Full-stack AI implementation services: helps businesses design and integrate AI across their tech stack — for teams that want AI built and shipped, not just advised.

name: Easy Advanced Translations
desc: AI Shopify store translation (by Northwest): translate products, collections, theme text, metafields and even hard-coded and third-party-app text across languages, with a choice of engine (its own, Google, OpenAI or DeepSeek), image translation, protected terms and Shopify Markets support.

name: Easy Bundles
desc: Shopify bundle builder for build-your-own-box, gift-box, mix-and-match, fixed-price, volume and subscription bundles, with bundle inventory synced across Shopify and 3PLs and POS support. Priced on bundle sales rather than orders: free up to $500 a month, Essential $29 up to $3,000, Growth $49 up to $5,000, Scale $99 up to $10,000, with 14-16% off on annual billing. 4.9 stars over 1,216 reviews as of 4 Sep 2026.
DMARC, SPF and DKIM monitoring — stop others sending email as your domain.
name: EasyDMARC
EcomXray
desc: Shows cost price, gross margin, current stock and net units sold over 30, 90 and 365 days for every Shopify product, with restock advice from real sales velocity. The analytics are free; Pro at $29 a month adds in-place product editing, SEO fields, an activity log and a Chrome extension.

name: eDesk
desc: E-commerce helpdesk: one unified inbox for Amazon, eBay, Shopify and email, with order data and an AI Agent that bills per resolved outcome. Free plan; paid from $39/agent/mo (annual).

name: ElevateForward
desc: An operational execution and alignment platform (Elevate Studio) for scaling companies, structured in three layers — Strategy (set priorities and initiatives), Execution (track initiatives, workstreams, ownership and KPIs), and Momentum (adoption, change management and follow-through). It turns strategy into structured, visible execution rather than task lists.

name: ElevenLabs
desc: Market-leading AI voice platform: hyper-realistic text-to-speech, voice cloning, dubbing, sound effects and conversational agents — plus a developer API and, since August 2026, a hosted MCP connector that runs inside Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. Free tier to test voices before you pay.

name: EmailListVerify
desc: Email verification with never-expiring pay-as-you-go credits — bulk list cleaning, real-time API, inbox-placement testing and free DMARC/SPF tools, plus a credit-based email finder.

name: Emergent
desc: AI app builder. Describe what you want and Emergent builds full-stack web apps for you — an agentic, credit-based platform that turns prompts into working software with no manual coding.
Modular HR, payroll and recruitment platform for small and mid-size employers.
name: Employment Hero
EngageBay
desc: All-in-one CRM, marketing, helpdesk and live chat for small teams — a genuine free tier (250 contacts) and per-user suites that undercut the big names.
Workplace platform for visitor sign-in, desk and room booking, deliveries and emergency notifications.
name: Envoy
Essential Loyalty
desc: Shopify loyalty and rewards app metered on loyalty-influenced orders rather than total orders, with VIP tiers and referrals on the free plan.

name: Evey Events
desc: Sell event tickets straight from your Shopify store: unlimited events and ticket types, QR check-in, attendee data at checkout. Free to install at $1 per ticket; the monthly plans buy a lower per-ticket rate.

name: Evolve
desc: AI-native training and enablement platform for enterprises: an LMS with branded academies, an AI course generator, job-skill simulations with AI counterparts, an assessment center and performance analytics — used by 100+ deployed enterprises.

name: Expandi
desc: LinkedIn and email outreach automation for sales teams and agencies — smart limits, warm-up and multi-account management.

name: ExpertEx
desc: A unified AI studio: chat across multiple models (GPT-4, Gemini), generate images, video and voice, and reuse prompts — multilingual, all in one workspace.

name: Expertise AI
desc: AI sales agent for B2B websites. Replaces a static chatbot with a live, RAG-grounded agent that holds buying conversations, qualifies visitors and routes them to reps or calendar slots — HubSpot-first, with visitor intelligence.

name: ExpertSender
desc: E-commerce marketing automation with a built-in customer data platform: email, SMS, web and mobile push plus on-site messages, behavior-triggered workflows, product recommendations and segmentation on unified store data.

name: Fast Bundle
desc: Shopify app that covers every bundle format from one place — fixed bundles, mix-and-match, build-your-own, BOGO, volume breaks and AI frequently-bought-together — on product pages, in the cart and in POS. Metered on the sales your bundles generate rather than on catalogue size: free under $500 a month, then $19, $49 and $139, with $299 for uncapped bundle revenue. Shopify pulled the app after a July 2026 security incident and relisted it on 30 July.

name: Fastmail
desc: Private, ad-free email hosting with your own domain. Fast, secure email, calendars and contacts from an independent provider that doesn't mine your data. From 1 August 2026 you pick EU (Amsterdam) or US data residency, encrypted at rest on Fastmail's own servers — note that EU data is initially still replicated and backed up to the US while that infrastructure matures.

name: Feedvisor
desc: AI-driven Amazon and retail-media optimization: dynamic repricing, ad automation and analytics for brands and larger sellers on Amazon and Walmart.

name: Feedyio
desc: Shopify product-feed engine (by happyapps.cz) that generates and syncs feeds for Google, Meta, Pinterest, TikTok, Bing and 130-plus marketplaces and price-comparison sites, with strong coverage of the Central European channels (Heureka, Glami, Kaufland, Favi). Custom XML, CSV, TXT or JSON feeds are built from your own Liquid template, with category mapping, attribute rules and validation before products get rejected. Free tier up to 30 products; Basic $9.99 a month, Advanced $19.99, Pro $29.99, capped on catalogue size. Launched May 2022, 115 reviews as of 10 Sep 2026.
Case management for law firms: matters, intake, depositions, e-signature and AI document work.
name: Filevine
Finale Inventory
desc: Inventory and warehouse management for e-commerce and wholesale: multi-channel stock sync, purchasing and barcode workflows that scale with order volume.

name: Fireflies.ai
desc: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes and summarizes your calls across Zoom, Google Meet and Teams — searchable notes, action items and CRM sync, so nobody takes minutes by hand.

name: Flatpay
desc: Card terminals, POS systems and online payments for physical shops across Europe, sold with on-site installation and 24/7 support. One flat rate on every card type: 1.49% on the terminal, 1.69% on the POS tiers, with daily payouts and no monthly subscription. Read their separate price list before you sign, though: it carries a £995 minimum monthly turnover with a £39 charge when you miss it, £410 for a replacement terminal, and POS installation from £995 to £2,495 — all excluding VAT (read 13 Aug 2026).

name: FlexiQuiz
desc: Online quiz and test maker for educators, trainers and businesses: build graded exams, assessments and simple courses with certificates, timed tests, question banks and analytics — from a genuinely free tier.

name: Flippa
desc: Marketplace for buying and selling online businesses, SaaS, apps and domains. Self-serve, so the due diligence is yours. Sellers pay a listing fee from about $29 plus a success fee starting near 3% — a bracket rate on the whole sale price, not a marginal one.

name: Flocksy
desc: A dedicated creative team for one flat monthly fee. Unlimited graphic design, video editing, motion graphics and web design — your marketing never waits on a freelancer again.

name: folk
desc: Lightweight, collaborative CRM for managing contacts and relationships. Centralize your network and personalize outreach without the bloat. A mobile app (Contacts by folk) adds on-the-go search, one-tap contact capture with business-card scanning, voice notes and interaction tracking across WhatsApp, LinkedIn, email and calendar.

name: Foxit
desc: PDF editing, OCR and organising priced under Acrobat: $129.99 per user per year for the desktop editor, or $159.99 for Editor+, which now bundles Foxit eSign with 150 envelopes a year. A perpetual licence is $209.99 once, and the AI Assistant stays a $49.99/year add-on.

name: Frase
desc: AI-powered SEO content writing and optimization. Research, outline, write, and optimize articles that rank — all in one place.
Invoicing and accounting aimed at freelancers and service businesses, priced by billable clients.
name: FreshBooks
Freshchat
desc: AI-powered customer messaging from Freshworks: live chat and chatbots across your website, app, WhatsApp and Instagram, with a unified agent inbox and automation that deflects repetitive questions.

name: Freshservice
desc: AI-powered IT service management (ITSM) from Freshworks: cloud help desk, ticketing, asset management and workflow automation to run IT support and internal service desks without heavy ITIL overhead.
Suite of separately-sold products: Freshdesk support, Freshservice IT, Freshsales CRM, Freshchat and Freshcaller.
name: Freshworks
FullEnrich
desc: B2B contact enrichment with waterfall data. Find verified emails and direct phone numbers for prospects by combining 15+ data sources in one lookup.

name: Gamma
desc: Turns a prompt or rough notes into a deck, document or webpage draft. Credit-metered: the free tier gives 400 one-time credits and carries Gamma branding, Plus is €10/month (€8 on annual billing) for 1,000 monthly credits, read 16 Aug 2026 from an EU address. Output still needs a human pass for high-stakes decks.

name: Gelato
desc: Global print-on-demand platform: design, produce and ship custom products (apparel, wall art, mugs, photo books) locally in 30+ countries with no inventory — integrates with Shopify, Etsy and WooCommerce.

name: GeoStock
desc: Shows per-location stock on the product page plus a store-locator map, so shoppers can see which branch has the item. From $9.99 a month, Plus $29.99. It displays inventory rather than managing it.

name: Geotargetly
desc: Geo-targeting toolkit — location-based redirects, content swaps, popups and personalization by country, state and city, priced by traffic volume.

name: GetResponse
desc: Email marketing with landing pages, automation and webinars in one suite, priced by contact count. Starter is €16/month (€13.12 billed annually) and allows a single automation workflow; unlimited workflows start on Marketer at €54. The better rates need long commitments.

name: Getscreen
desc: Browser-based remote desktop and remote-support software: connect to any computer with no client install, share one-click access links, transfer files and record sessions — for IT teams, MSPs and remote support.

name: Gixo
desc: Seven separate AI workspaces — decks, articles, visuals, briefs, proposals, legal drafts and books — each sold on its own plan. Published floors run from $10 a month for Quill, Lumen and Prism to $49 for Arc, with a 14-day trial on six of the seven and no bundle price.

name: Glide
desc: No-code app builder — now sold as Glide Classic, next to the newer GlideOS — that turns spreadsheets and databases into working business apps: internal tools, client portals and field apps, with workflows and an API.

name: Goflow
desc: Multichannel e-commerce operations: orders, inventory, listings and shipping across all your marketplaces in one dashboard. Goflow Core is free forever (500 orders, 3 users) and automates Amazon MCF fulfilment for TikTok Shop orders; the vendor states eligible orders may qualify for 35% savings on Amazon MCF rates (vendor mail, 27 Jul 2026). Goflow lists 250+ integrations across marketplaces, shipping, 3PL and accounting (goflow.com, 12 Aug 2026), and a nocnoc integration keeps Latin American listings, inventory, orders and fulfilment in sync from inside Goflow (vendor mail, 5 Aug 2026).
Helpdesk built for ecommerce: tickets, automations and an AI agent, priced by volume rather than by seat -- though the entry tier caps you at three users.
name: Gorgias
GrapeLeads
desc: Lead-finding for web developers and agencies — surfaces local businesses without websites from Google Maps, with contact details, on signup credits.

name: Grapevine
desc: Shopify-native survey platform for post-purchase, NPS, CSAT and attribution questions, with unlimited responses on a single plan. Reports revenue and AOV per marketing channel, targets surveys by order value, product, country, payment method or customer, runs on-site, by email and on Shopify POS, and exports to Shopify Flow, Klaviyo and GA4; survey data can be queried with your own AI assistant through the vendor's MCP server. One plan at $25 a month with a 14-day trial and no free tier. Launched August 2017, 221 reviews as of 10 Sep 2026.

name: Gravity Forms
desc: Self-hosted WordPress form builder with conditional logic, payments and deep integrations. Licences run about $59/year for one site up to $259 for unlimited. WordPress-only, and much of the advanced power sits in paid add-ons that can add $99–349/year.

name: Guesty
desc: Property management for short-term and vacation rentals: bookings, guest messaging, channel distribution and pricing in one dashboard. Guesty Lite is roughly $9/month plus about 1% per reservation for one to three listings; Pro and Enterprise are custom-quoted. Heavy for a single listing.

name: Gusto
desc: Payroll, benefits and HR in one friendly platform. Automated tax filings, employee onboarding and time tracking — run payroll for your whole team in just a few clicks.

name: Healthie
desc: All-in-one practice management and EHR for health, wellness and nutrition providers: scheduling, telehealth, secure messaging, billing and a branded client portal — plus a full API (GraphQL + webhooks) for automation. Built to scale with group practices.

name: Heard
desc: Done-for-you bookkeeping and taxes built for therapists and a growing range of health-and-wellness practices — SLPs, dieticians, chiropractors, audiologists, coaches, massage and physical therapists: monthly books, quarterly tax estimates, annual filing and S-corp support by specialists who know the niche.

name: Hello Bar
desc: Sticky bars, popups, slide-ins and full-screen takeovers for lead capture, with A/B testing and targeting rules. The meter is popup views rather than signups, so a traffic spike raises the bill however few emails you captured. Reported tiers start near $29–39/month for roughly 50k views.

name: HelpCenter
desc: Shopify helpdesk with live chat and an AI FAQ builder: email, chat and Messenger in one ticket queue, plus SEO-friendly FAQ pages. Free to install; paid from $5.99 to $49.99 a month.

name: HiBob
desc: HRIS with onboarding, time-off and people analytics, built for scaling mid-size companies. Quote-only, per employee per month: third-party estimates cluster in the mid-teens, plus a one-off implementation fee reported at roughly 10–20% of the annual value. Get the number in writing.

name: Hive
desc: Project management and team collaboration in one workspace. Plan projects, assign tasks and centralize communication so work keeps moving.

name: Hopp
desc: Business travel management from Bolt, branded Hopp: book and control company rides from one dashboard, with per-person and per-group spend limits, automated ride reports, expensing integrations and a single consolidated monthly invoice. No activation cost and no minimum commitment — you pay per ride.

name: Hostinger
desc: Affordable, fast hosting with an AI website builder built in. Free domain, free SSL and 24/7 support — perfect for founders launching their first MVP or side project.

name: Housecall Pro
desc: Field service management for home-service businesses. Schedule jobs, dispatch techs, send quotes and invoices, and take payments from one app.

name: HubSpot
desc: CRM platform with marketing, sales, service and content hubs on one contact database. Free for up to 2 users and 1,000 contacts; Starter is advertised at $7 per seat a month against a $20 list price, and Professional starts at $800 a month with a mandatory $3,000 onboarding fee on top.
Time tracking with screenshots, activity levels, GPS and payroll integration for distributed teams.
name: Hubstaff
Iconosquare
desc: Social analytics, reporting and competitor benchmarking, deepest on Instagram and the core networks. Free for one user and two profiles, then Starter €9/month, Launch €33 and Scale €69 billed yearly. Tiers gate on seats and profiles, so agencies managing many brands climb faster than the entry price suggests.

name: iContact
desc: Straightforward email marketing for growing businesses. Build campaigns and automations with drag-and-drop design and deliverability support.

name: IDrive
desc: Cloud backup across many devices, with versioning, snapshots and physical seed-and-restore shipping. Personal is 5 TB at $9.99/month, shown at $6.99 on annual billing — but that discount is first-year only and the renewal step is about 43%, so budget on year-two rates.

name: InboxAlly
desc: Email deliverability tool that trains your sender reputation: engagement-based signals keep your campaigns and cold outreach out of spam and in the primary inbox — works alongside any ESP or email platform.

name: Increff
desc: Warehouse management plus algorithm-driven merchandising and inventory optimisation for omnichannel retail. There is no public pricing and no flat fee — every deal is quoted case by case against warehouses, users and modules, so budget for an enterprise implementation.

name: Insightful
desc: A work intelligence platform: workforce analytics plus AI process capture — time tracking, how work actually flows, and insider-threat detection as a paid add-on, priced per seat.

name: Instapage
desc: Enterprise landing-page and conversion platform: build, personalize and A/B-test post-click landing pages at scale, with ad-to-page mapping, heatmaps and fast AMP pages — built for paid-ads and demand-gen teams.

name: Intelis
desc: Monitors competitor prices on Google Shopping and direct competitor sites and reprices your Shopify catalogue automatically with AI matching rules. Priced by tracked products or variants: $49 a month for 100, $179 for 1,000, $249 for 2,000 and $399 for 5,000, each with a 14-day trial.

name: InVideo
desc: Turns a prompt or script into a first-draft video with AI voiceover, templates and stock footage. Plans are monthly credit allowances that do not roll over: Plus $20 a month, Max $100, Generative $200, Elite $1,000, roughly 15% cheaper paid yearly. The pricing page no longer lists a free tier, so Plus is the cheapest way in.

name: involve.me
desc: Interactive funnel builder: quizzes, calculators, assessments and payment pages with built-in email sequences and a built-in CRM for the leads they capture, plus built-in A/B testing that splits traffic between two versions and scores them on completion rate and submissions — free tier to start, paid tiers priced by live-funnel count from $29/mo annual.
Time and attendance tracking with facial recognition, GPS and payroll-ready timesheets.
name: Jibble
Joiin
desc: Financial consolidation and group reporting for multi-entity, multi-currency organisations — connects Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, FreeAgent, Zoho Books, Fortnox, MYOB, Pennylane and Puzzle, with unlimited users and reports on every plan. Forecasting is now part of the product: linked P&L, balance sheet and cash flow up to 60 months out, with an AI assistant that drafts the assumptions. Integration list read on joiin.co/integrations, 15 Sep 2026.

name: Jotform AI Agents
desc: Build AI chatbots and customer-service agents in minutes — no code required. Handles leads, support tickets and bookings 24/7. Integrates with your existing forms and CRMs.

name: Jubilee
desc: Bankruptcy petition preparation, document automation and case management for legal practices. $95 per case pay-as-you-go, or annual plans from $995 for up to 36 filings to $4,995 for 500. Size the tier to your real filing volume; sporadic filers do better per case.

name: Kartra
desc: All-in-one platform for selling online: landing pages, email automation, funnels, memberships and checkout in one tool — no plugins to stitch together.

name: Katana MRP
desc: Cloud manufacturing and inventory platform for product businesses. Live inventory control, production scheduling and order syncing across your sales channels — know exactly what to make and when.

name: Keap
desc: CRM, sales and marketing automation built for small businesses. Capture leads, automate follow-up and manage your pipeline in one place.
Password manager and privileged access management for teams, with a zero-knowledge architecture.
name: Keeper Security
Kinsta
desc: Managed WordPress hosting on Google Cloud, with free migrations and 24/7 support. From $35/month for one site (10 GB, metered on 20 GB bandwidth or 35,000 visits), or $30/month billed annually at $350 a year. Overage bills per 1,000 extra visits; Kinsta gives no partner-only discount codes.

name: Kit
desc: Email marketing built for creators (formerly ConvertKit). Grow your list with landing pages and forms, then automate newsletters and sell digital products from one place; a beta Kit MCP connects AI assistants like Claude directly to your account. Recent additions: a new landing-page editor, Dynamic Content, Newsletter Sponsorships, and App Store integrations on paid plans — SMS via SlickText, Patreon member sync (tier and support data in automations), Luma/Eventbrite event sync, and two-way HubSpot CRM sync on Pro.

name: Kite
desc: Shopify discount toolkit (by Skai Lama) built on native Shopify Functions: free gift with purchase, buy X get Y, tiered and volume discounts, progress bars and bulk codes. Free to install for the first 50 discount orders a month, then $29; Starter $29, Growth $49, Pro $99.

name: Kiwi Sizing
desc: Shopify size charts and AI fit recommendations, built to cut returns. Free plan carries a Kiwi watermark; Premium is $7.99 a month and the only paid tier without order-volume charges. From Staytuned.

name: Kixie
desc: Power dialer with SMS and CRM integration for outbound sales teams. Kixie publishes no seat price: three tiers separated by how many lines they dial, with the multi-line AI voice detection, ConnectionBoost, Conversation Intelligence and DNC compliance all sold as add-ons on top.

name: Koongo
desc: Shopify app that syncs product feeds, stock and orders across Amazon, eBay, Bol, Zalando, Allegro and 500-plus channels from one dashboard. Free tier for 100 items; paid plans from $39 a month, separated by refresh frequency, with surcharges beyond the included limits.

name: KrispCall
desc: Virtual numbers across 100+ countries with a shared dashboard, dialer and CRM hooks, from about $12/user/month on annual billing. Calls and SMS are pay-as-you-go from a separate credit balance, so compare per-country call rates at your volume rather than the seat price.

name: Landingi
desc: Landing page builder with 400+ templates, from $29/month for unlimited pages and 5,000 visitors; A/B testing and pop-ups start at $49. Roughly half what Unbounce and Instapage charge, and the trade is no AI traffic routing, no real-time collaboration and thinner technical control.

name: LangShop
desc: Shopify translation and currency app (by Aheadworks) that localises products, themes, checkout, SEO and third-party app content with OpenAI, DeepL Pro or Google Cloud Translation, or with professional agency translators, and adds a geolocated language and currency switcher. Glossary and content rules keep terms consistent. Free plan for one language and 50 products; Basic $10 a month or $100 a year, Standard $40 or $400, Advanced $75 or $750, each capping languages and translated products. Launched September 2016, 480 reviews as of 10 Sep 2026.

name: Later
desc: Visual social media scheduler and planner. Plan, preview and auto-publish posts across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and more from one calendar.

name: Leadfeeder
desc: Website visitor identification for B2B sales. See which companies visit your site and what they viewed, and turn anonymous traffic into a warm pipeline.

name: Leadpages
desc: Landing pages, pop-ups and alert bars, with unlimited traffic on every Leadpages plan where metered rivals count visitors. Conversion plans run $99 (Grow) to $399 (Scale), alongside a separate HTML Pub publishing line at $10–49. The value pick rather than the optimisation pick.

name: LearnWorlds
desc: Create, sell and scale online courses. Build a branded school with interactive video, assessments, certificates and a built-in checkout.

name: Leavo
desc: Team time-tracking, attendance and overtime banking with transparent per-user pricing and a 30-day free trial.

name: lemlist
desc: Cold email outreach and sales engagement. Build personalized multichannel sequences (email, LinkedIn, calls) with built-in deliverability tools, and trigger them off buying-intent signals its agents surface. An MCP server at app.lemlist.com/mcp puts the same actions inside Claude or ChatGPT: create, update, start and pause campaigns and sequences, manage leads, enrich emails and read team analytics in plain language - the enrichment calls spend credits like anywhere else in the product.

name: LettrLabs
desc: Automated direct-mail marketing: design, personalise and send physical mailers — handwritten letters, postcards — at scale, synced with your digital campaigns and tracked for ROI.

name: Lindy.ai
desc: An AI teammate that lives in Slack: @mention it and it works across your other tools, sits in meetings for shared context and runs jobs on a schedule. Sold per user — Plus $29.99/month for 3k credits, Pro $99.99 for 15k — so cost tracks headcount, and a removed seat runs to the end of the cycle.

name: Livestorm
desc: Browser-based webinars with registration, automated emails, polls and analytics. There is no plan price: Pro sells attendee credits at €2.50 each, bought a year up front, and one credit is spent per unique participant per session — a four-part series to 200 people costs 800 credits.

name: Lucrovox
desc: AI phone agent for local service businesses — answers missed calls, books jobs and captures leads 24/7 for trades like HVAC, plumbing and roofing.

name: ManyChat
desc: Comment-to-DM and chat funnels for Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp and SMS. Flows are button-and-script based, so an unexpected reply falls back. The free tier holds 25 active contacts and paid plans are banded by list size — $14/month at 250 contacts, $139 at 25,000.

name: MarketerHire
desc: Hire pre-vetted expert marketing talent on demand: growth marketers, paid ads specialists, email pros and more — matched to your business within days.

name: Marketing 360
desc: All-in-one marketing platform for small business. Websites, CRM, ads, email and reputation management under one roof, with a unified reporting dashboard (their 'Intelligence' analytics) that pulls every channel, lead and sale into one view — and real humans to help run it.

name: Meeri
desc: Shopify app that recovers abandoned carts with AI-written web push notifications instead of email or SMS — no address or phone needed to subscribe, and no commission on recovered revenue. Free for 300 notifications a month; Pro is $4.99.
Meeting recorder and note-taker: transcription, summaries and searchable meeting history.
name: MeetGeek
Melio
desc: Bill payments for small businesses by bank transfer or card, syncing with your accounting tools. The free Go plan covers five ACH transfers a month, then $0.50 each; Core is about $25/month. Card payments carry a flat 2.9%, which only pays off when you are deliberately floating cash.

name: MigrationPro
desc: Shopify app that imports products, customers, orders, collections, URLs and 301 redirects from WooCommerce, Wix, Magento and 30-odd other platforms. One-time payment rather than a subscription, from $29 self-service or $300 done-for-you, after a free ten-record demo.

name: MindStudio
desc: Visual builder for AI agents and workflows across 200+ models, with model usage passed through at provider cost and no markup. The real bill is therefore subscription plus model spend: Individual is about $20/month, and a looping agent burns provider credits until you set caps.

name: Miro
desc: Visual collaboration platform: an infinite online whiteboard for brainstorms, diagrams, workshops and planning — with templates, voting and AI that generates diagrams and summaries, built for real-time and async teamwork.

name: Mktg.ai
desc: Always-on AI marketing analyst: unified creative visibility, live performance signals and plain-language questions over your own spend data — no public pricing, demo-first.

name: Modelize
desc: Shopify app that generates on-model, lifestyle, studio and flat-lay product photos in bulk from your existing catalogue images, using Google's Gemini image models. Free tier is 3 one-off images; Starter $19 a month buys 100 images, Pro $49 buys 250 at up to 4K, Enterprise $99 buys 500 with extras at $0.20 each.

name: Modge
desc: Desktop time tracking and workforce analytics for remote and hybrid teams: automatic hours, app and URL classification, shift adherence, leave, payroll-ready timesheets and Stripe invoicing. Basic $4 per seat per month on annual billing ($5 monthly), Pro $5.50, Premium $7; screenshots are optional and off by default. 14-day trial, no card.

name: Momence
desc: Booking and business management for class-based businesses — yoga and fitness studios, gyms, salons and schools: scheduling, memberships, payments, marketing automations and a member app in one place.
Work management platform with boards, automations and views — plus separately-priced CRM, Dev and Service products.
name: monday.com
Moosend
desc: Email marketing and automation platform — drag-and-drop campaigns, automation workflows, landing pages and subscription forms, priced by contact-list size with a 30-day free trial and pay-as-you-go email credits as an alternative.
Fleet management: ELD compliance, AI dash cams, vehicle tracking and driver safety scoring.
name: Motive
MRPeasy
desc: Cloud manufacturing ERP for small manufacturers. Plan production, track inventory and manage orders and procurement so a growing workshop runs without spreadsheets.

name: Murf
desc: AI voiceover generation for explainers, courses and product video. Metered in generation hours per year rather than per month: Creator is about $29/month for 24 hours a year, and every retake of a script bills again.

name: Mycroft
desc: Security and compliance platform plus managed service for companies without a security department: a GRC platform mapped to CMMC, FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA and GDPR, bundled with cloud and application security, device management, third-party risk and awareness training, and backed by a Risk Operations Center staffed by its own experts around the clock. 150+ native integrations across AWS, Azure, GCP and the major code hosts. Three packages — Platform, Scale, Managed — and none of them is publicly priced. Mycroft Technologies Inc.; not the Mycroft AI voice assistant.

name: Navan
desc: Business travel and expense management in one. Book trips, automate expense reports and control spend with real-time visibility.

name: NeuroAds
desc: AI chat widget for Shopify trained on your catalogue, orders and policy pages that replies in the shopper's own language, with rich product cards, discount codes, order tracking and add-to-cart inside the chat. Free for 200 conversations a month; paid runs $19, $49 or $119 a month for 800, 3,000 or unlimited conversations. Launched June 2026 with six App Store reviews.

name: Nextify.ai
desc: AI ad-video generator for advertisers and e-commerce sellers: turn a product image, a script or a brief into a vertical or landscape video ad, with avatar presenters, lip-sync, product image sets and image cloning in the same workspace. Eight tools in one credit pool — Create Video Ad, Viral Video, Video Cloning, UGC Product Video, Lip-sync, Image Generator, Listing Images and Image Cloning — running on Seedance, Kling, MiniMax, HeyGen, GPT Image and Nano Banana models you pick per generation. Metered in credits per second of output rather than per finished video, with the cost shown on the generate button before you commit.

name: Ngram
desc: AI video creation for product and marketing teams. Turn docs, screenshots and recordings into polished, on-brand videos — scripted, storyboarded and produced with AI on a credit-based model, with a brand kit, captions and subtitles, AI voiceover and an AI avatar presenter. A published blog post or doc URL is a valid starting point in its own right: paste the link and it handles the research, script, storyboard, voice and style choice and the render in one sitting, with no editor in the loop, and hands back a shareable public link or an embed.

name: NiceJob
desc: Automates asking customers for reviews and showcases them on your site. Reviews runs about $75/month and Pro around $125, plus a one-off setup fee near $199. Reporting and customisation are fairly basic, and the automation only amplifies the service you already deliver.

name: noCRM
desc: Action-driven sales tool from France's Positive Group: every lead carries a next step instead of a form to fill in. Three per-seat tiers — Starter €11, Expert €22, Dream €33 per user a month on annual billing (€19/€29/€39 monthly) — but two-way email, WhatsApp, VoIP and team permissions are Dream only. 15-day trial, no free plan.

name: NordVPN
desc: Secure VPN with threat protection for business & remote teams

name: Notify Me
desc: Shopify app to recover lost sales on out-of-stock products: back-in-stock notifications, pre-orders and wishlists that keep customers buying instead of bouncing.

name: Nouswise
desc: AI research agent that answers only from a library you curate — your documents plus vetted sources — with reports, flashcards and audio recaps on every tier, and MCP tools, web search and a shared workspace only from Pro up. Built for knowledge-intensive and regulated organisations: SOC 1 / SOC 2 Type I/II, data in Europe or the US, and an on-premises install for confidential material. Published pricing is 0$ Starter, 19.99$/month Essential and 49.99$/month Pro with Enterprise on quote (re-verified 18 Aug 2026), but their own homepage still shows $10 and $40 for the same tiers — Nouswise says that is an animation artefact, we re-checked in a normal browser and it is not — so get the figure confirmed before you subscribe. The “100% verifiable, zero fabrication” claim is the vendor's own.

name: Nutshell
desc: Sales CRM with built-in email marketing for small teams. Manage your pipeline, automate follow-ups and run campaigns from one place, without enterprise complexity. Full API access is included on every plan.

name: Omniseo
desc: AI search visibility (GEO) tracking. Monitor and improve how your brand shows up in AI answers across ChatGPT, Google AI and other channels — track prompts, competitors and citations to grow AI-driven discovery.

name: Oneflow
desc: Digital contract platform for the full lifecycle — create, negotiate, e-sign and archive interactive contracts, with AI-assisted contract features and CRM/HR/ATS integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce), from €250/month (5 users, annual billing).

name: Optizen
desc: Shopify app that puts video upsells and bundles on product, cart and post-purchase pages, using your own clips or AI-generated ones. Free plan covers one campaign and five conversions; Starter is $9.99/month and Pro $29.99/month, but the AI video generation is metered on top — 2 credits a month on Starter and 5 on Pro, then $2 or $1.50 per extra clip.

name: Outgrow
desc: Interactive content builder for quizzes, calculators, polls and assessments. Generate and qualify leads with engaging, no-code experiences, then sync them straight into Klaviyo via OAuth for email/SMS follow-up, or into Attio for CRM handoff.

name: Ownr
desc: Register or incorporate your business in Canada online and manage the legal admin: sole proprietorship or incorporation in minutes, plus contracts and documents — without a lawyer for every step. Canada-only, RBC-owned. Through our partner link, readers save 15% on registration or incorporation.

Employer of record and global contractor management for hiring where you have no legal entity. EOR is $699 per employee a month, contractors $29. Two costs sit in the FAQ rather than on the price card: a refundable deposit per EOR employee, and an FX fee when payment and contract currency differ.
name: Oyster
PagePulse
desc: Per-page site analytics with heatmaps and AI-summarised insights. Free for one member and one page; Starter at $29/month buys one member and two pages. The tiers gate on members and tracked pages at once, and the 'unlimited traffic' promise carries a fair-use footnote.

name: Pangram
desc: AI content detector. Identifies AI-generated text with a focus on minimizing false positives — used by educators, publishers and platforms to verify whether writing is human or machine, via web app and API. The vendor's Pangram 4.0 release (July 2026) claims a false-positive rate of 1 in 10,000, detection of output from the newest frontier models, resistance to "humanized" text written to evade detection, and improved boundary detection between human and AI passages. An early research preview adds AI image detection, flagging which segments of an image appear AI-generated and verifying C2PA content credentials where present.

name: Papaya Global
desc: Enterprise workforce-payments platform unifying global payroll, EOR hiring, contractor management and cross-border payments in one system — finance-first, with same-day local payouts on owned payment rails and deep ERP/HRIS integration. Premium, quote-only pricing.

name: Parallel AI
desc: AI agent platform for sales, marketing and support: build AI employees on every major model, run Smart Lists for lead generation and enrichment, and schedule content and support agents from one place. Free tier at 50 credits, no card; paid from $99 a month for 2,000.

name: Parim
desc: Workforce management for shift-heavy operations — staffing agencies, security, events — with unlimited users on every plan. Pricing starts from £47/month but every tier is quote-only: they price on functionality and the number of shifts you schedule.

name: PartnerStack
desc: The partner platform we run our own 58 programmes on: affiliate tracking, lead and deal registration, partner payments and a marketplace where B2B partners find you. Quote-only at every tier.

name: Passpack
desc: Team password manager for small businesses and MSPs. Store, share and organize credentials with zero-knowledge encryption, role-based access, MFA, device registration, full audit trails and shared team vaults — at a low per-user price. An iOS app arrived in August 2026; Android is announced but not yet out.

name: Payoneer
desc: Local receiving accounts for freelancers and sellers paid by international clients and marketplaces. Free to open — the cost sits in the fees: 1% on non-local currency received, 1.2–4% to withdraw to a bank in another country, whether or not currency is converted, $1.50 flat to withdraw locally, and a $29.95 annual fee waived above $6,000 received.

name: PDWare
desc: Resource and capacity planning for project teams. Plan who works on what, balance workloads and forecast capacity in real time so projects don't stall on people bottlenecks.

name: Pecan AI
desc: Predictive AI that builds churn, LTV and demand models from your own data and delivers the results into your warehouse or CRM. Priced by prediction batches rather than seats, and quote-only at every tier.

name: Piktochart
desc: Infographic, report and poster maker with template libraries and AI credits — the free plan allows 2 downloads, Pro is $10 per member/month billed annually, and PDF/PowerPoint export starts at Business ($17).

name: Pingtree
desc: AI-assisted funnel builder and lead-distribution platform — build funnels and forms by prompt, then route, track and monetise the leads across lead-gen, affiliate and media-buying campaigns.

name: Pipedrive
desc: Sales-first CRM built around a visual pipeline: track deals, automate follow-ups and forecast revenue — designed for small and mid-size sales teams. A native MCP server (launched mid-2026) connects it to AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude for natural-language CRM actions.

name: Pippit
desc: AI marketing-content maker by CapCut — turns a product link into marketing videos, avatar presenters, talking photos and sales posters, with scheduling and multi-platform publishing. Credit-based, with a free tier that needs no card. Seedance 2.5 is now listed among its video models: clips up to 30 seconds, text timestamps to pin key moments, footage extension for longer scenes and reference inputs to steer the direction — although their own model page still describes it with "upcoming" wording (checked 4 Aug 2026).
