A separate Story Studio section has since appeared in their own navigation, grouping AI Drama, AI film, AI Movie, AI Script and AI Workflow (checked 3 Sep 2026).

name: Pixel Union
desc: Premium Shopify themes bought once rather than by subscription: Pixel Union's own six run $100–360 and sister brand Out of the Sandbox's $220–499. A theme is a starting point — the conversion lift comes from how you configure and populate it, not from the purchase.

name: Planday
desc: Employee scheduling and time tracking for shift businesses, owned by Xero. Starter is €2.99 per user/month with a 5-user minimum; Plus is €4.99 per user plus a €25 monthly platform fee and a 10-user minimum. 30-day trial, no card.

name: Plansom
desc: AI-assisted planning for tasks, goals and team collaboration, with a free Starter tier that keeps tasks unlimited. Pro is about $14.99/month or $149.99 a year. A smaller player next to Asana and ClickUp, with fewer integrations and a smaller ecosystem around it.

name: Plesk
desc: Server control panel for agencies and hosters running many sites — per-domain management, security and one-click stacks. Licensed per server from about $14–18/month for 10 domains. Domain caps drive the tier, and a roughly 26% average price rise took effect in January 2026.

name: Post Purchase Upsell Hero
desc: One-click post-purchase upsell and downsell offers for Shopify, with targeting rules, AI product recommendations, A/B testing and a revenue dashboard. There is no monthly fee: the Performance plan is $0 and charges 2.5% of the first $20,000 of upsell revenue it generates each month, with everything above that free — so the bill tops out at $500 and is nothing in a month it sells nothing.
SMS marketing for Shopify stores: campaigns, automations and opt-in tools.
name: Postscript
PreOrder Now
desc: Shopify pre-orders with badges, partial payments, mixed-cart warnings and back-in-stock emails. Priced by which Shopify plan you are on rather than by features: $19.95 on Basic up to $99.95 on Plus.

name: Prezi
desc: AI presentation maker for dynamic, non-linear decks that stand out from standard slides — turn ideas into polished, interactive presentations fast.

name: Pricefy
desc: Competitor price monitoring and dynamic repricing for e-commerce — AI product matching, price-intelligence dashboards, feed channels and autopilot repricing.

name: Printify
desc: Global print-on-demand network. Create custom products and automate your e-commerce fulfillment without holding inventory.

name: Process Street
desc: Recurring work as trackable checklists and SOPs, with approvals and conditional logic. Pricing is opaque: Startup begins near $100/month for up to five members and steps up to a custom Pro tier in the $1,500/month range, with seat minimums on top.

name: ProtectMyOrder
desc: Shopify checkout upsell for premium services: package protection against lost and stolen parcels, carbon-neutral shipping and free returns, sold on the cart page, in checkout or through a custom widget, with fixed, dynamic or percentage pricing and an A/B test against half your traffic. Free to install; the App Store plan takes 19.99% of delivery protection revenue with a $20-a-month minimum and leaves the claims with the merchant, who keeps the other 80%. On the vendor's own pricing page a 44.99% tier puts their agents on those claims, and a further 30% hands them the liability for refunds and replacements.

name: Proton
desc: Privacy-first suite from the makers of ProtonMail — encrypted mail, calendar, drive, VPN and password manager under one account, with a free tier and paid bundles.

name: Proton Drive
desc: End-to-end encrypted cloud storage from a Swiss provider. Free at 2–5 GB; Drive Plus about $3.99/month annual for 200 GB. Because Proton cannot read your files there is no server-side search inside documents, integrations are thinner, and losing your credentials without recovery loses the data.

name: Pumper Bundles
desc: Shopify bundle app by Profit Pumper: unlimited product bundles, quantity breaks, volume and cart discounts, BOGO and free-gift offers, with cart drawer and page builder integrations. The plans are a revenue ceiling rather than a feature ladder — all four carry identical features. Free covers up to $300 of attributed extra revenue, Starter $9.99/month up to $1,000, Growth $29.99 up to $5,000 and Unlimited $49.99 with no cap.

name: PushOwl
desc: Shopify web-push and omnichannel marketing, now part of Brevo. One-click push lets stores re-engage shoppers who never leave an email — recovering abandoned carts and browsing sessions — then layer in email, SMS and WhatsApp on Brevo's deliverability stack. Usage-based pricing: you pay for what you send, not list size.

name: Pylon
desc: B2B customer support platform built for Slack and Microsoft Teams. Manage tickets, track issues, and deliver white-glove support directly where your clients chat.

name: Pythago
desc: AI analytics and ROI tracking for dropshippers — real-time ROAS optimization, product research and competitor tools across one or more Shopify stores.

name: Qoyod
desc: Saudi accounting and e-invoicing platform built around ZATCA compliance, used by 25,000+ businesses. From 1,200 SAR a year (~$320) for one user and one location — but ZATCA Phase 2, the part most businesses actually need, starts on the Pro tier.

name: Quartile
desc: Retail media optimisation across Amazon Sponsored Ads and Amazon DSP, Walmart, Instacart, Criteo, Google, Meta and Microsoft, and ChatGPT Ads as well since August 2026 (the vendor told us on 31 Aug 2026; we have not seen it ourselves), sold as a platform plus a dedicated account team rather than a self-serve tool. Demo-led with no public pricing of any kind: no tiers, no entry rate, nothing on the pricing page (read 7 Aug 2026). The 41% average ROAS uplift on their homepage is the vendor's own claim.

name: QuickBooks UK
desc: Intuit's accounting platform for the UK market — bookkeeping, VAT and Making Tax Digital submissions, invoicing and payroll as a paid add-on. Plans run from £10 a month for sole traders to £123 for the twenty-five-user tier, excluding VAT, with a 30-day trial.

name: QuickSigner
desc: Legally-binding e-signatures with unlimited documents and no per-envelope caps: send a secure link and recipients sign from any device without creating an account. ISO/IEC 27001-certified, AATL signatures, valid across the US, UK and EU — a fair-priced DocuSign alternative.

name: QuillBot
desc: Paraphrasing, grammar, summarising and plagiarism checking in one box of writing utilities. The free tier caps paraphrasing at 125 words and two modes, and Premium is €19.95 a month month-to-month against €8.33 billed annually — 2.4 times the price for the right to leave.

name: Quo
desc: Shared business numbers, texting and AI call summaries for small teams, formerly OpenPhone. About $15/user/month on annual billing, plus telecom taxes and surcharges in 16 US states. Call reliability off Wi-Fi is the recurring complaint, and there is no video conferencing.

name: Rank Math
desc: WordPress SEO plugin with schema, on-page analysis and rank tracking. The free version is generous enough that many sites never need to upgrade; PRO, from about $6.99/month billed annually, earns its keep once you want rank tracking, Content AI credits or many client sites.

name: ReachStream
desc: B2B contact database with a published price instead of a quote: unlimited contact and company views on every tier, with the meter running on exports rather than on looking. Free is $0 for 100 export credits a month; Starter $39 a month ($29 annually) for 5,000, Pro $59/$49 for 10,000, Business $99/$79 for 20,000 and three seats. Annual billing takes 20% off the price and changes nothing about the allowance. Read on their own pricing page on 10 September 2026.

name: Readymode
desc: Predictive dialler with compliance tooling and supervisor monitoring for high-volume outbound floors. Starter is $239 per license/month and iQ $299 for teams of five or more, both with free outbound minutes under a fair-use policy (prices read on their own pricing page on 17 Aug 2026, after a vendor price change effective 1 Aug 2026). Premium per seat, and predictive dialling carries real TCPA compliance responsibility.

name: Reclaim.ai
desc: Auto-schedules tasks, habits and meetings around your stated priorities. Google Calendar-first, so Outlook-heavy teams are out, and the free tier is limited. Paid seats run about $8–10/month on Starter and Plus, roughly 29% cheaper on annual billing.

name: Reditus
desc: Affiliate-program software plus marketplace for B2B SaaS: launch, manage and scale a partner program with tracking, automated payouts and affiliate discovery.

name: Remote People
desc: Employer of Record and global hiring in 150+ countries. EOR from $199 per employee a month with no setup fee, no deposit and no minimum headcount; contractor management from $29, US PEO from $99. Recruitment is charged separately at 20-25% of annual salary.

name: Replit
desc: Browser-based coding environment with instant deploys and an AI agent. Billing is effort-based: Core is $20/month including $25 of credits, Pro $95/month billed annually including $100. Credits expire monthly and a complex agent session burns them fast, which makes production costs hard to budget.

name: Reply.io
desc: AI-driven sales engagement platform. Automate your cold outreach across email, LinkedIn, and calls while keeping the human touch. Now includes a mobile app (Jason AI) for iOS and Android to run outreach on the go.

name: respond.io
desc: Shared inbox for WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, SMS, email and live chat, with workflow automation, broadcasts and AI agents on top. Priced per monthly active contact rather than per seat: $79 Starter, $159 Growth and $279 Advanced, around 20% off paid yearly, with a 7-day trial and no card. The catch is where the line sits: automation, broadcasts, AI agents and the API all start at Growth, so the entry plan is the inbox without the engine (read 13 Aug 2026).

name: Restream
desc: Multistreaming studio: broadcast one show to YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook and Twitch at once from the browser, with guests and local recordings. The channel caps are the business model — 3 on Standard at $190 a year, 5 on Professional — and extra seats start at Professional, at $25/month; the Standard column offers none.

name: Retouch4me
desc: AI retouching plugins for photographers (Photoshop-compatible, Mac/Windows) — perpetual licences per plugin ($145 for most, $179 for Dodge & Burn and Clean Backdrop), full-suite subscriptions from $169 a year with 2,400 retouch credits, or cloud retouching in credit packs at $24 for 100, $59 for 300 and $179 for 1,200. Free to try first: two free plugins, three free apps and a demo on every paid plugin (site, read 7 Sep 2026).

name: Rippling
desc: Workforce platform that unifies HR, IT and Finance in one system of record: run payroll and benefits, manage hiring, onboarding and time tracking, and provision devices and app access automatically — with policy-driven automation across employee data, approvals and compliance.

name: Riverside
desc: Records podcasts and video locally at each end, so guests on poor connections still come out broadcast-quality. Recording hours are unlimited; the meter is separate-track download time, 15 hours a month on Pro ($35 monthly or $24 on annual billing, re-read 7 Sep 2026), and hitting that cap stops new separate-track downloads until the next cycle rather than billing you more.

name: RocketReach
desc: Contact data and prospecting: look up verified work and personal email addresses plus direct and mobile phone numbers, filter on 50+ criteria, then push the result into Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Salesloft or Bullhorn. Sequences, an AI email writer and Autopilot jobs that keep a saved search running come with the paid plans, with technographics, org charts and intent topics higher up. The database size (700 million professionals, 60 million companies) and the 98% accuracy figure are RocketReach's own.

name: Ruby
desc: Live human receptionists answering your calls, plus chat. Billed by receptionist-minute: $250/month for 50 minutes and $395 for 100, rising to $1,725 for 500, with chat bundled from $115/month. Premium rates that pay off only when a missed call is a lost client.

name: Runpod
desc: Serverless GPU compute platform. Rent high-end NVIDIA GPUs by the hour to train and deploy your own machine learning models.

name: Salesflare
desc: CRM for small B2B teams that auto-logs emails, meetings and contact details from your inbox and calendar. $29–99/user/month with no caps on contacts or pipelines. Deliberately lean: no built-in dialer, no quoting or invoicing, and basic reporting unless you export.

name: Salesflow
desc: LinkedIn outreach automation for outbound sales teams — connection requests, follow-up sequences and Open InMails, with email steps for multichannel campaigns, plus an admin panel and seat management for agencies. Priced per seat, from $99 at one seat down to $24.99 at a hundred.

name: Salesmessage
desc: Business texting and SMS marketing in one shared inbox. Reach customers where they actually reply — two-way texting, automation and team collaboration.

name: SaneBox
desc: Email triage that moves low-priority mail out of the inbox and works with any provider. From $4.54/month for one account on a two-year commitment — $9.49 month to month — up to $22.04 for four accounts with every feature. The honest catch: you are paying monthly to filter mail that modern email clients increasingly sort for free.

name: Scarcity.AI
desc: Three Shopify urgency apps — low stock counter, countdown timer and live visitors counter — that read real data but let you choose which true number the shopper sees.

name: Scrolly
desc: Free Shopify app from Effectify that adds a customizable floating back-to-top button and, optionally, infinite scroll on collection pages, with no code and no paid tier. The button is a safe convenience; the infinite scroll replaces the paginated collection URLs crawlers use, so it is a merchandising decision rather than a styling one.

name: Seamless.ai
desc: B2B contact database with AI list-building, plus an MCP server so Claude or ChatGPT can run the searching and enrichment. Nothing above the free plan (1 user, 50 credits) carries a published price; the only quantity their FAQ names is a Pro floor of 10,000 annual credits (read 7 Sep 2026). Independent tests put deliverability near 74%, and contracts auto-renew with 30-60 days' notice to cancel.

name: Section Library
desc: Shopify app that adds 200+ ready-made theme sections plus AI-generated custom ones (Gemini 3.1 Pro), all inside the native theme editor so layouts change without a developer. Free plan gives 8 credits a month; paid runs $9, $19 or $29 a month for 25, 55 or 90 credits. Live since October 2023 with a single App Store review.

name: Securify
desc: Country blocker and fraud filter for Shopify: blocks countries, IP ranges, bots, VPNs and risky emails at checkout, and holds suspicious orders automatically. Free plan; paid $5.99 to $49 a month.

name: Seel
desc: Shopper-paid returns and shipping protection for Shopify, BigCommerce and Adobe Commerce. Customers add Worry-Free Purchase at checkout and Seel pays the refund instead of you — free for the merchant.

name: Selixer
desc: Shopify profit dashboard that nets ad spend, COGS, returns and fees out of revenue and reports what you keep per product, campaign and customer, built for fashion and apparel brands. Essence $149 a month, Catalyst $299 and Aether $399, each with a 14-day trial; the profit waterfall and campaign ROAS start at $299.

name: Seller Investigators
desc: Amazon FBA reimbursement recovery on contingency: a free 48-hour audit, then a 25% commission charged only after Amazon deposits recovered funds. No subscription. Ask which cases Amazon would have settled automatically before you sign.

name: Seller Snap
desc: AI repricer and seller-analytics platform for Amazon and Walmart — what the vendor calls game-theory repricing, aimed at Buy Box share rather than racing to the bottom, plus min/max profit calculation, 80+ analytics data points and imports from tools like InventoryLab and SkuVault. Starter is $100/month billed annually (annual only); month-to-month starts at $250. 15-day free trial, no credit card. A July 2026 interface release adds live Buy Box insight with SKU-level filters, multi-store management from one screen including bulk cost updates, repricing from mobile, historical inventory-value tracking, saved views, customizable columns and a dark mode.

name: Sellfy
desc: No-code store builder for creators to sell digital products, subscriptions and print-on-demand merch — with zero transaction fees and built-in social-media selling.

name: Sendcloud
desc: European e-commerce shipping platform: connect 160+ carriers, print labels in batches, show delivery options at checkout, send branded tracking (email, WhatsApp, SMS) and run a self-service returns portal — with rules-based shipping automation. Available to online retailers in 8 countries (Netherlands, Belgium, UK, France, Germany, Austria, Italy, Spain). Free plan available.

name: Sentaro
desc: Email threat detection that flags phishing, risky and malicious messages right in your inbox. Surfaces the dangerous emails that look perfectly normal — before anyone clicks.

name: SEO Space
desc: SEO tool built exclusively for Squarespace, delivered as a Chrome extension paired with a web dashboard. The extension runs inside the Squarespace editor and on live pages, scoring each page and saying in plain language what to change and where the setting lives; the dashboard adds site-wide audits, keyword rank tracking, backlink and competitor data, local SEO tools and scheduled white-label PDF client reports. Pricing is keyed to the number of websites rather than seats, which is why it suits freelancers and studios managing client sites. There is a genuinely usable free plan — a scan of up to 50 pages without a card; paid pricing is keyed to the number of websites, with the most-popular position (5 sites) at $33.33/month billed annually, read 17 Aug 2026.

name: SEOmatic
desc: SEO suite for Shopify from Aheadworks: unlimited image compression with alt text, AI-generated meta titles and descriptions, SEO audit, schema markup and both XML and HTML sitemaps. Free up to 10 products; the paid ladder is priced purely by catalogue size — $15, $25 or $40 a month for 500, 2,000 or 5,000 products, with a 14-day trial. Live since 2015, rated 4.4 over 114 App Store reviews.

name: Serpstat
desc: All-in-one SEO platform — keyword research, competitor analysis, rank tracking, site audit and backlink data — from $50/month on annual billing ($69 month-to-month), with a 7-day trial that takes a card and auto-renews.
Job management for trades and service contractors: scheduling, quotes, job cards and invoicing.
name: ServiceM8
Shiftie
desc: Rota building, clock-ins, leave and shift swaps for shift-based businesses. Charged per active employee — £2.75 a month for the first 30 and £1.50 for each one above that, with no minimum and a custom quote past 200 staff. Not an HR or payroll platform, so those stay separate purchases.

name: Shipdock
desc: Shopify pickup points, multi-carrier label printing and cash-on-delivery tracking, strongest on the Central European carrier networks.

name: Shippo
desc: Multi-carrier shipping software for e-commerce. Compare rates, print discounted labels and automate tracking across carriers — shipping that scales with your store.

name: Shoeboxed
desc: Turn paper and digital receipts into organized, IRS-ready expense data with OCR plus human verification — syncs with QuickBooks and Xero.

name: Shorby
desc: Link-in-bio pages and short links, with messenger deep-links into WhatsApp or Telegram and retargeting pixels firing on every click. It charges from about $15/month where Linktree does not charge at all, so the gap only pays off if messenger selling or ad retargeting is genuinely your funnel.

name: Shore
desc: Booking and business software for local service businesses (salons, barbers, wellness, coaches): 24/7 online appointments via your website, Google and Instagram, calendar and staff scheduling, client profiles, automated reminders that cut no-shows, plus email marketing and POS. Fixed monthly price with unlimited bookings — no per-booking commission.

name: Signal House
desc: SMS and Voice API positioned as a Twilio alternative. Usage-based with no platform fee: $0.0065 per SMS segment with no minimum, down to $0.0030 above 10m, and $1.00 a month per local number. A2P 10DLC fees are published; voice rates are not.

name: Signeasy
desc: E-signature and contract management for SMBs — unlimited signing and sending, templates, audit trails and integrations, priced per seat.

name: SignNow
desc: Electronic signatures and custom eSignature workflows by airSlate. Send, sign and manage documents on any device — legally binding and team-friendly.
Competitive intelligence on web traffic, search and ads — what your competitors' visitors do.
name: Similarweb
SimpleTexting
desc: SMS marketing and business texting: run mass-text campaigns, two-way conversations and automations with compliance built in.

name: SimplyBook.me
desc: Online booking and scheduling system for service businesses — booking website and widget, provider calendars, automated reminders and online payments. Free plan for 50 bookings a month with one provider; paid plans from EUR 11.90 a month billed annually.

name: Smartli
desc: AI writing suite for e-commerce: product listings, ad copy, SEO text and brand assets. Monthly runs $39 (Starter) to $299; on annual billing Starter disappears and Pro drops to about $24/month. Each of the nine tools is competent rather than deep, so leaning hard on one job means outgrowing it.

name: SmartSuite
desc: One flexible work management platform to plan, track and automate any process. Projects, CRM and operations side by side — replace a stack of scattered tools with a single source of truth.

name: Smarty Discounts
desc: Shopify discount engine for the rules the native one cannot express: capped and fixed-amount discounts that hold up across currencies, tiers by quantity, subtotal or weight, BXGY, gifts and mix-and-match, targeted by product, customer, cart, market, country or company. Free plan available; Lite $9.99 a month or $99.99 a year, Pro $25.99 or $259.99. Each tier includes two discounts at the level above. Launched January 2025, six reviews as of 4 Sep 2026.

name: SMTP.com
desc: Reliable transactional and bulk email delivery via SMTP relay and API: high-deliverability sending for app notifications, receipts and campaigns, with real-time analytics and dedicated IPs — built for volume senders.

name: SMTP2GO
desc: Reliable transactional and bulk email delivery. Send via a simple SMTP relay or API with strong deliverability, real-time analytics and global sending infrastructure.

name: SocialBee
desc: Social media management and scheduling with content categories. Plan, recycle and publish posts across all your channels from one calendar.

name: Softr
desc: Build custom AI business apps, client portals and internal tools without code. Connect Airtable, Google Sheets or your data and launch in an afternoon.

name: Spiky.ai
desc: AI meeting intelligence for revenue teams — records and analyses sales calls, tracks keywords and talk patterns, and coaches reps. Free tier at 3 meetings per user, then $15 to $40 per user per month on annual billing.

name: Spocket
desc: Dropshipping platform with vetted US and EU suppliers. Find fast-shipping products, add them to your store in a click and automate order fulfillment.

name: Stackable
desc: Shopify discount app (by Optizio) that folds several discounts into one code: order, collection and shipping discounts combined, a progress type that raises the discount as the cart grows, and checkout upsells on the top tier. No free plan — Growth is $19.99 a month, Unlimited $99.99, both with a 7-day trial.

name: Stamped
desc: Reviews, ratings and loyalty platform for e-commerce: collect product reviews and user-generated content, run rewards and loyalty programs, and show social proof to lift conversions on Shopify and other stores.

name: Stampezee
desc: Digital stamp cards for local businesses, replacing paper punch cards. Stamp Start is free for one branch, one card and up to 100 stamps; Stamp Lite is $29.99/month for two branches and three cards. Public pricing stays thin, so re-check the tiers before committing.

name: StoreFAQ
desc: Builds SEO-friendly FAQ pages and product FAQ accordions with JSON-LD schema on Shopify, plus an AI chatbot, instant answers and live chat. Free plan covers 100 FAQ page views; Professional $7.99 a month, Growth $14.99 and Enterprise $49.99, all metered on page views and AI conversations.

name: StoreSEO
desc: SEO suite for Shopify: bulk meta titles and descriptions, image compression and alt text, JSON-LD schema, sitemap submission, instant indexing requests and Search Console reporting, with AI credits for generated copy. Free forever for 25 products; paid runs $14.99, $39.99 or $249.99 a month by product count.

name: Storista
desc: Shopify app that turns TikTok, Reels and UGC clips into shoppable video widgets — carousels, stories, grids and spotlights — with auto-sync from TikTok and Instagram. Free for 10 videos, $15 for 50, and AI product tagging from $49.
Interactive product demos you can embed, with analytics on who watched what.
name: Storylane
Streak
desc: CRM built directly inside Gmail: manage pipelines, leads and deals from your inbox with email tracking, mail merge and shared views — ideal for teams that live in Google Workspace.

name: Success.co
desc: Strategy execution and OKR platform. Turn goals into action: set objectives, track KPIs and scorecards, run meetings and align teams so strategy actually gets executed rather than just planned.
Daily planning that pulls tasks from your other tools into one deliberate schedule.
name: Sunsama
SupaEasy
desc: No-code Shopify Functions generator (by Nextools): build and migrate custom discount, checkout, payment, shipping and validation logic from the Shopify Admin, with a migrator for deprecated Scripts and an AI generator that writes functions from a plain-language brief.

name: Superfiliate
desc: Creator-led growth for D2C brands: run influencer, affiliate and referral programs in one platform across Shopify, Meta and TikTok Shop — discovery, automation, gifting and revenue tracking.

name: SupportBee
desc: Email ticketing for collaborative customer service: a shared team inbox where every agent has their own login, plus an integrated knowledge base and, on the upper tier, a customer portal. Per seat, no free plan.

name: Surfer (SurferSEO)
desc: Content optimization against live SERP data, and since 2026 a tracker for how often a brand is cited in AI answers like ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews. Billed yearly at four tiers.

name: SurveyMonkey
desc: Survey and feedback platform: build surveys, collect responses at scale and analyze results for market research, CX and employee feedback. A native Salesforce integration pushes responses straight into Salesforce, triggers workflows off the answers themselves (churn-risk follow-up or an NPS detractor landing on a rep's desk, for instance) and ties feedback back to accounts and pipeline, so sales and CS read it inside the tool they already work in rather than in a separate reporting dashboard.

name: SurveySparrow
desc: Conversational surveys and NPS with a polished respondent experience. A limited free plan, then roughly $19–39/month on Basic up to $149 on Business. Response limits on the lower tiers and a contact-sales wall on API and higher volume make budgeting fiddly, and there is no true monthly billing.

name: Survicate
desc: Customer feedback platform for continuous surveys: NPS, CSAT and in-product micro-surveys across web, in-app, email and link — with templates, audience targeting and native integrations (Segment and RudderStack among them) that pipe feedback straight into your CRM and analytics.

name: Switcher Studio
desc: Multi-camera live production and streaming from iPhones and iPads you already own, with overlays and pay-per-view monetisation. Studio runs around $45/month on annual billing. iOS-only — no Android or desktop app — and wireless multi-cam is only as reliable as the venue's Wi-Fi.

name: Synthesia
desc: AI avatar video for training, explainers and onboarding: type a script, no camera or actors needed. Priced in video-minute credits — Basic is free with about 10 minutes a month and no downloads, Starter $18/month billed yearly for 120 minutes a year. Re-generating an edit spends the minutes again.

name: Tapita AI SEO Blog Builder
desc: AI blog builder for Shopify: generates SEO-oriented posts with titles, images and keyword suggestions, embeds your products, and schedules bulk publishing from a drag-and-drop editor. Free with 50 one-off credits; Pro is $9.99 a month on Shopify Basic but rises with your Shopify plan to $14.99, $39.99 or $69.99.

name: Tapita SEO Optimizer
desc: All-in-one Shopify SEO app: site audits with LLMs.txt for AI search engines, bulk and AI-written metadata, image alt text and compression, JSON-LD schema, broken-link auto-redirects and one-click speed fixes. Free plan available; Basic is $9.99 a month and Pro $39.99 on Shopify Basic, plus $5, $30 or $60 more a month on Grow, Advanced and Plus.

name: Tapstitch
desc: Fashion-first print-on-demand for brand-builders: premium heavyweight blanks (streetwear tees, oversized hoodies), bigger print areas and made-to-order apparel with no inventory — integrates with Shopify.

name: Tax1099
desc: Per-form e-filing of 1099s, W-2s and related forms, falling to about $0.68 a form at high volume, with an eFile Plus subscription near $249/year for frequent filers. TIN matching, W-9 requests, state filing and corrections can each carry their own charge, so tally the add-ons.

name: TaxCycle
desc: Professional tax preparation and CRA e-filing for Canadian accountants and bookkeepers. Quote-based and priced by module and firm size, with reported figures ranging from roughly CAD 1,680 into five figures for full suites. Canada-only, and not a consumer filing app.

name: Team Pulse
desc: Projects, tasks, chat, files and a light CRM pipeline in one tool. The tiers gate on members and projects at once, and the pipeline does not exist below the $79 Growth plan — Starter at $29 is a single seat with five projects. The listed rates assume annual billing.
Advertising optimisation for Amazon and Walmart sellers, with inventory and catalogue signals.
name: Teikametrics
Tellent
desc: Modular people-management platform — applicant tracking (Recruitee), core HR and performance management with AI automation, for hiring and managing teams.

name: Tenable
desc: Exposure and vulnerability management (makers of Nessus): scan, prioritize and remediate security weaknesses across IT, cloud and OT — for security teams of any size.
Pre-employment skills testing: assessment library, custom questions and candidate scoring.
name: TestGorilla
TextExpander
desc: Text-expansion tool: you type a short abbreviation and it expands into a stored snippet system-wide on macOS and Windows and in Chrome, with fill-in fields, nested snippets, date maths and scripting. The real product is the team layer — a shared snippet library with permissions, sign-up by email domain, auto-subscribe for new hires, usage statistics and SSO — aimed at support, clinical-admin, recruiting and sales teams that need everyone sending the same approved wording. The vendor self-attests SOC 2/SOC 3 and HIPAA compliance with a BAA available, which is the clearest argument for paying rather than using a free expander. There is a free plan (5 active snippets); paid tiers start at $5 per user/month billed annually, and the 30-day trial of the full product needs no credit card.
Business SMS for support and sales teams: shared inboxes, automations and compliance tooling.
name: Textline
TheTop
desc: An AI 'chief of staff' that pulls your calendar, inbox and news feeds into one ranked morning brief through Google or Microsoft, then drafts the replies and quick actions the brief calls for. One plan at $8 a month, or $80 a year, with five connected sources, five brief refreshes a day and a seven-day free trial.

name: Thordata
desc: Proxy infrastructure and scraping stack — residential, mobile, ISP and datacenter proxies plus SERP/web-scraper APIs, priced per GB, IP or 1K requests.
All-in-one platform for small service businesses: CRM, scheduling, invoicing, reviews and marketing.
name: Thryv
TicketTailor
desc: Low-fee event ticketing and box-office software: sell tickets online, manage check-in and keep more of your revenue without per-ticket booking fees.

name: Tidio
desc: Live chat, ticketing and the Lyro AI agent in one platform: AI answers routine questions from your own data, hands the rest to the team with context, and Flows chase leads proactively. Lyro also plugs into Zendesk, Intercom, Salesforce and 20+ platforms without migration, but only on Premium.

name: TiXel
desc: Shopify app for Meta and TikTok pixels, with unlimited pixels, product-level scoping and server-side Events API tracking on one flat plan.

name: TnC
desc: Shopify app that puts a mandatory “I agree to the terms” checkbox on the cart and on the Buy It Now, PayPal and Apple Pay express buttons, logs the consent timestamp against the order, and can show it only for chosen products or countries for GDPR and age gates. From $7.99 a month, with the consent timestamp starting at $12.99; the checkbox inside Shopify's own checkout page needs Shopify Plus and a $19.99 tier the App Store listing does not show.

name: Todoist
desc: Task manager for individuals and small teams: quick capture, due dates and projects across devices. The free plan caps you at five projects and reminds you only at the moment a task comes due; reminders set for some interval before, and more than one per task, are Pro at about $5/month billed annually. A to-do app, not a project suite with timelines or dependencies.

name: Toggl
desc: Time tracking for freelancers, consultants and agencies, with budgets, rates and profitability per project. Free for a limited number of users; Starter $9/user/month and Premium $16 on annual billing. The paid line is drawn at whether you bill clients — track time for personal discipline and the free tier covers it.

name: Top Echelon
desc: Recruiting software for agencies and staffing firms: TE Recruit is an ATS and CRM with resume parsing, pipeline management, hotlists and job-board integrations, while TE Network is a split-placement network for sharing roles and candidates with other recruiting firms.

name: Tradify
desc: Specialized job management software for trade businesses. Handle quoting, scheduling, and invoicing from the field.

name: Trainerize
desc: Personal training and fitness-coaching platform. Deliver workout and nutrition plans, message clients and take payments from one branded app, so trainers can coach more clients online.

name: Trainual
desc: Documents SOPs and runs new-hire onboarding, with AI that drafts and updates training docs from your own account context. Not publicly priced: all four plans are quote-gated behind a demo, and the only figure the pricing page publishes is a one-time implementation fee of $1,000.

name: Tresorit
desc: End-to-end encrypted cloud storage and secure file sharing. Protect sensitive business documents with zero-knowledge security and granular access controls.

name: Turbotic
desc: Enterprise automation orchestration. Manage your entire ecosystem of RPA, AI, and scripts from a single control tower.

name: Typewise
desc: AI agents for customer service that resolve requests end to end and take action in the systems you already run — CRM, ERP, billing, commerce — configured in plain language instead of flowcharts. Pricing starts at $1 per resolution on their own site (read 2026-08-17) and there is no published plan table, so what counts as a resolution is the number to pin down before a pilot.

name: UENI
desc: A done-for-you small-business website, built for you rather than a builder you have to learn: a one-time build fee (promoted at $79 against a usual figure near $599) plus $24.99/month, including domain, email and a launch call. DIY editing is limited and the seven-day promise often slips.

name: UltaHost
desc: Budget-friendly web hosting across shared, VPS, WordPress and dedicated plans — NVMe SSD storage, free SSL and migration, DDoS protection and 24/7 multilingual support, from 30+ global data centers.

name: Unbounce
desc: Landing page builder for paid campaigns, with A/B testing and Smart Traffic routing each visitor to the best-converting variant. From $74/month (Build) to $187 (Optimize), and the visitor caps — around 20,000 a month on Build — push you up a tier when a campaign takes off.

name: Uniqode
desc: Dynamic QR codes and digital business cards with real-time scan analytics — connect offline touchpoints to measurable results and capture leads.

name: UniTel Voice
desc: Virtual business phone system for small teams. Get a toll-free or local number with auto-attendant, call routing and a mobile app — no hardware.

name: Unleashed Software
desc: Inventory and MRP software for manufacturers and wholesalers — real-time stock across warehouses, purchasing, sales orders and batch or serial tracking. The entry price covers 3 users and 100 sales orders a month; past that the bill stacks up.

name: Upsell.com
desc: Shopify upsell app, formerly ReConvert: AI-driven cart, checkout and post-purchase upsell and cross-sell funnels, frequently-bought-together and product page recommendations, A/B testing and analytics with segmentation. The free plan is development stores only, and the three published tiers — $4.99, $9.99 and $19.99 a month — stop at 200 orders or $200 of upsell revenue; above that the listing only says charges rise.

name: UpsellPlus
desc: Upsells, cross-sells and free gifts across Shopify product pages, cart, checkout, post-purchase, customer accounts and POS, with AI recommendations and A/B testing in 23 storefront languages. Free plan runs one offer; Launch is $49/month, the Shopify Plus tier $119 and Scale $199 — each capped by how much upsell revenue it may generate ($500, $2,000 and $5,000 a month).

name: UptimeRobot
desc: Uptime monitoring with a generous free tier — website, port, keyword and API checks down to 60-second intervals, status pages, integrations and mobile apps.

name: VEA
desc: AI built for entrepreneurs, not enterprises: VEA learns your business like a great employee would, finds the constraint keeping you stuck, and helps you solve it — then finds the next one.

name: Velora
desc: Unified operations platform for nonprofits: Keela (donor CRM), Aplos (fund accounting) and Raisely (online fundraising) as one connected suite — donor management, campaigns and finances built for charities instead of adapted from business software.

name: Vida AI
desc: Deploy autonomous frontline voice agents. Let AI answer calls, book appointments, and handle FAQs 24/7 without sounding robotic.

name: VidPal
desc: Autonomous content engine for faceless and topic-based channels: it discovers trending stories in your niche, auto-generates short-form videos and carousels with AI voiceovers, and auto-publishes them across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and more.

name: Vista Social
desc: Unified social media management and publishing. Schedule posts, manage conversations, and track analytics across all your brand accounts.

name: Volza
desc: Export-import trade intelligence: search customs-level shipment records to find verified buyers and suppliers. Startup is $1,500 a year for 182 countries and 2 users; the 200-country coverage and 10 users start at $4,500 (read 2026-09-01). Downloads run on a published credit allowance, from 360,000 full-shipment credits a year.

name: Voye
desc: Pooled eSIM data for travelling teams, billed on actual usage rather than prepaid bundles, with per-user spend controls. Coverage and speed vary by country and carrier partner, so pilot your heaviest routes first — the vendor's roaming-savings figures stay claims until your invoice confirms them.

name: VWO
desc: A/B testing and conversion optimization platform. Run experiments, heatmaps and personalization to lift conversions without developers.

name: Warmup Inbox
desc: Standalone email warm-up service — automated inbox warming, deliverability monitoring and integrations for Google, Outlook, Zoho and SendGrid.

name: Wati
desc: WhatsApp Business API platform for sales and support: shared team inbox, bulk broadcasts and no-code chatbots — plus Astra, its AI agent builder for agents that actually resolve conversations (orders, refunds, bookings, lead qualification) across WhatsApp, web and voice. Its omnichannel inbox now also carries TikTok DMs natively (all plans, no extra cost) alongside Instagram and RCS — with ad-to-chat context that shows exactly which TikTok ad triggered a conversation. It now ships its own MCP server as well: connect Claude or ChatGPT once and manage contacts, send WhatsApp campaigns, read past chats and build agents in plain language, while sends still run on your own approved templates and the full history stays in the Wati dashboard. Wati's own page puts the cost like this: free for current paid Astra customers with no usage cap during launch, and full MCP access on every Astra plan for new customers (checked 4 Aug 2026).

name: Way
desc: Shopify store locator on Google Maps with no API key needed, priced by location count rather than by feature.

name: Weave
desc: Phone, texting, payments and reviews unified for the front desk, tuned to dental, optometry and small healthcare practices. Quote-based per location: owners commonly report $400–700 per location per month plus a one-time setup fee near $750. Get the all-in number in writing.

name: WebCatalog
desc: Turn web apps into tidy desktop apps and manage multiple accounts side by side. Less tab chaos, more focus — your whole stack organized in one place.
Visual website builder that writes production code — design, CMS, hosting and ecommerce in one place.
name: Webflow
WebinarGeek
desc: European live and automated webinar platform — viewer-tier pricing, engagement tools, CRM integrations and GDPR-friendly hosting. The vendor states you can now generate a full webinar — including polls, quizzes and a registration page — from a plain-text description, with UTM tracking and post-webinar redirects on the registration page (vendor mail, August 2026).

name: Wegic
desc: AI website builder that generates and hosts sites from a conversation — credit-based, with custom domains and code export on higher tiers. Wegic's own help center documents images only by upload or external URL; the built-in image generation the vendor promotes, including a product-photo-to-product-page pass, is not in that documentation and we have not tested it. A one-click optimize pass audits a published site for SEO and site-health problems and applies the fixes itself — vendor-announced in July 2026, and not something we have tested.

name: WhatConverts
desc: Lead tracking and marketing attribution. Capture calls, forms and chats and tie every lead back to the campaign that drove it, for clear ROI.

name: Wholesale Gorilla
desc: B2B wholesale inside an ordinary Shopify store: custom prices per customer group, a signup and approval flow, net payment terms, wholesale-only shipping rules and a quick-order form, so trade buyers order from the same storefront as retail customers. Nothing is metered — the three tiers gate features, not volume. Lite $34.95 a month, Advanced $69.95, Premium $149.95, no free plan and a 21-day trial. Read on the App Store and the vendor's own comparison chart on 8 September 2026.

name: Wing Assistant
desc: Managed virtual assistants for founders and teams: delegate admin, inbox, scheduling and repetitive tasks to a dedicated, trained assistant.
Video hosting built for marketing — player customisation, viewer analytics and lead capture.
name: Wistia
Wiz Checkout Upsell
desc: Shopify checkout and post-purchase app from Skai Lama: upsells, volume discounts, subscription upgrades and free gifts, plus checkout banners, trust badges, input fields and gift messages, with thank-you and order status page offers behind them. Essential is $49/month but post-purchase only; the checkout-stage editing the app is named for starts on the $99 Plus Growth plan, and $199 Checkout concierge adds A/B testing across all extensions.

name: Woodpecker
desc: Cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform priced by contacted prospects — unlimited team seats and email accounts, built-in warm-ups, deliverability tooling and a lead finder.

name: World Businesses for Sale
desc: International marketplace for buying and selling established businesses — restaurants, shops, services and manufacturers — free for buyers, with broker plans (listing fee plus 1-3% commission) or no-commission pay-as-you-go listings, and 24/7 guidance for sellers.

name: WP Rocket
desc: WordPress caching and performance plugin: page cache, lazy loading, file optimisation and CDN integration from one settings screen. Licensed annually from about $59 for one site to $299 for many, all tiers feature-identical. Stop paying and you keep your settings but lose updates and support.

name: Wrike
desc: Work management for mid-to-large teams running cross-functional projects: reporting, workflows, approvals and resource management. Free up to five users; Team about $10/user/month and Business $25 on annual billing, with a five-seat minimum on Business.
Cloud accounting for small business: bank reconciliation, invoicing, bills and reporting.
name: Xero
Zedonk
desc: Fashion-industry ERP for small and mid-size brands — modular sales, production, inventory and wholesale management with a B2B digital showroom, priced per module from £166/mo billed annually.

name: Zeffy
desc: Fundraising, ticketing and donation payments for nonprofits at genuinely $0 — no platform, transaction or card-processing fees. The model is an optional tip prompt shown to your donors at checkout, which they can set to zero. Weigh that against the 2–5% paid platforms take from every donation.

name: ZenBusiness
desc: US business-formation service — LLC, S corp and C corp filings at $0 plus the state's own fee, with the money in the recurring stack around it: registered agent $199/year, Worry-Free Compliance $199/year (Advanced $299/year), operating agreement $99, EIN $99. Add-ons are priced individually rather than bundled into tiers (site, verified 25 Jul 2026).
Customer service suite: ticketing, messaging, voice, help centre and AI agents.
name: Zendesk
Zendrop
desc: AI dropshipping and print-on-demand for Shopify: browse 1M+ products from US and global suppliers, link them to your store and let fulfilment and tracking run automatically, with custom branding, POD and 3PL as you scale. Free to install, but linking products needs a paid tier — $29, $49 or $79 a month by product count, with per-order product and shipping cost on top.

name: ZenZap
desc: Secure work-chat for teams — organized channels, built-in tasks and workflows, AI agents and admin controls, as easy to use as texting.

name: ZoomInfo
desc: Enterprise B2B sales intelligence and contact database. Find verified company and contact data, buying signals and org charts to fuel outbound at scale.

name: SEOKart
desc: Shopify and BigCommerce SEO app with one-click AI optimisation: bulk meta tags, image alt text and file names, URL edits, JSON-LD schema and rich snippets, 404 fixing and 301 redirects, image compression for page speed, and a built-in keyword rank tracker with a Cruise Control auto-SEO mode. Free plan covers 50 pages and 10 keywords; Pro $20 a month or $216 a year for 1,000 products, Plus $30 or $324 for 5,000, Max $40 or $432 for 10,000 — above Pro the ladder buys catalogue size and nothing else. Read 12 Sep 2026.

name: Super
desc: Shopify gift app that adds paid or free gift wrap, gift boxes, greeting cards, a gift message and a price-hiding gift receipt to the product page, cart or Plus checkout, and tags those orders automatically for fulfilment. Basic $9.99 a month or $83.92 a year, Advanced $12.99 or $109.12, Pro $19.99 or $167.92; the free plan in the listing is for development stores only, and the $24.99 Plus tier that puts gift options inside the Shopify Plus checkout appears only in the vendor's own pricing article. Read 12 Sep 2026.

name: Trackr
desc: Shopify order-tracking app that replaces carrier links with one branded tracking page: estimated delivery dates, email, WhatsApp and US SMS updates, Apple and Google Wallet tracking, 2,100-plus carriers, shipping analytics and product recommendations on the tracking page. No free plan — Basic $10 a month or $96 a year for 400 shipments, Standard $45 or $432 for 2,000, Advanced $150 or $1,440 for 9,000, Enterprise $250 or $2,400 for 18,000, and $0.05 for every shipment above the allowance. Read 12 Sep 2026.

name: Nexis CRO
desc: Shopify app that runs a 34-check SEO and AEO audit across products, collections, pages and policies, rewrites the gaps with AI, deploys JSON-LD schema and an llms.txt file, and tracks whether ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity cite your store. Free plan; paid $9 to $44 a month.

name: Dynasort
desc: Shopify app that re-sorts collections, variant lists, search results and upsell blocks automatically, using recipes built from 60+ signals such as sales, margin, inventory and reviews. Free Demo tier; paid $99 to $499 a month.

name: Signitic
desc: Email signature management for Google Workspace and Microsoft 365: central templates, per-entity branding, and clickable banner campaigns with click statistics. ISO 27001 certified and hosted in Europe.

name: Kumo
desc: Shopify wholesale app from Cloudlift GmbH: unlimited custom pricing rules that apply automatically to named customer groups, CSV import and export of price lists, B2B registration forms with an approval workflow, and prices that update in the theme without code edits. Two plans and no free tier — B2B $15 a month, PLUS $30, both with a 7-day trial; everything PLUS adds requires Shopify Plus. Built for Shopify, launched November 2024, 5.0 stars over 9 reviews as of 16 Sep 2026.

name: MX AI
desc: Shopify app that plays a track of your choice in the background of a storefront, with control over the player's colour, size, position, volume, loop and autoplay, and sources ranging from an uploaded MP3 to Spotify, SoundCloud, Apple Music and YouTube formats. The free plan covers development and partner stores only; a live store pays $2.99 a month or $25.12 a year after a 7-day trial. Built for Shopify, live since January 2020, 4.8 stars over 66 reviews.
